en:
To All Watch Personnel Assigned to Clavering Boulevard 

Given the recent death of Captain Geoff Curnow near Holger Square, a new Watchtower has been authorized to secure the area. Tensions remain high following the incident, which cost a good man his life. Until the perpetrator has been identified, all squads are advised to question any suspicious persons entering the area. 

Note: The Engineering Corps is to be commended for working fast to put the additional fortifications in place. Whale oil will be delivered nightly to provide power to the new Watchtower. 

Major Anders Josiah
Defense Engineer Unit

en:
Eighth Entry
It's the 4th day of the Month of Rain. Morris is sick and so are the children. I've avoided it thus far, which is good fortune, since it has fallen on me to care for them. 

Ninth Entry
The city watch comes and goes, knocking on doors and asking for signs of plague. Even our neighbors cannot be trusted. Earlier, it was difficult to keep the children quiet. Now they sleep most of the time. 

Tenth Entry
The flies have set in. I try to keep them away, but I can barely get close, they sting so. Most of the time, Morris won't answer me when I try to talk to him from across the room.

Eleventh Entry
Morris is gone. I don't know what I'll do. For now all my hope is reserved for the children. Leaving the flat for a while near dawn, I found some plague bags from a guard booth while no one was around. It took a while, but I got Morris into one of the bags. At least his face is covered. 

Twelfth Entry
Young Robert has passed. The star of my sky is gone. 

[Page Missing]

Seventeenth Entry
Elise stopped breathing in the middle of the night. She was such a head-strong girl, I can hardly believe she was overcome. She was always near as I cut up hagfish or vegetables, arguing with me about everything. 

Eighteenth Entry
It is the 4th day of the Month of Wind. It has settled in that they are lost to me, all of them. I cannot bring myself to call the Dead Counter. 

Nineteenth Entry
I have the fever now. No guards come near any more.
old:
"第八条
这是降雨之月的第四天。莫里斯和其它孩子都生病了。当照顾他们的重担落到我身上后，他们坚持了这么久，已经算是很幸运的了。

第九条
城市巡警来了一次，他敲门询问是否出现了鼠疫的症状。但是现在，即使是我们的邻居也不可以信任。早些时候，我很难让这些孩子保持安静。然而现在他们大多数时候都在睡觉了。

第十条
很多苍蝇都飞了进来。我试图把它们赶走，但是只要我接近它们，就会被蛰。大多数时候，我从另一个房间呼唤莫里斯，他都不会回应我。

第十一条
莫里斯走了。我不知道该怎么办。现在我唯一的希望就是能好好保护其他的孩子。在破晓时分我出了趟门，发现在空的警卫亭里有一些裹尸布。我花了一些时间，总算是把莫里斯装进了其中的一个。最后我亲手将他的脸蒙上了。

第十二条
小罗伯特也走了。我的天空里再也没有星星了。

[页面丢失]

第十七条
埃利斯在半夜停止了呼吸。她是个如此坚强的女孩，我无法相信她也没能撑住。在我切盲鳗或是蔬菜的时候，她总是围在我身边，与我争论所有的事情。

第十八条
这是大风之月的第四天。他们所有人都离开了我，所有人。我已经连呼叫计死员的力量都没有了。

第十九条
看来我也发烧了。再也没有警卫会来这里了。
new:
第八条
这是降雨之月的第四天。莫里斯病了，孩子们也病了。到目前为止我还没有染病，这算是幸运，因为照顾他们的重担落到了我身上。

第九条
城市警卫来来去去，挨家敲门询问是否出现鼠疫症状。即使是我们的邻居也不可信。早些时候，我很难让孩子们保持安静。如今他们大多数时候都在睡觉。

第十条
苍蝇已经聚了过来。我试图把它们赶走，但它们蜇得太厉害，我几乎无法靠近。大多数时候，我隔着房间试着和莫里斯说话，他都不会回应我。

第十一条
莫里斯走了。我不知道该怎么办。如今我只能把所有希望寄托在孩子们身上。黎明前后我离开公寓一阵，趁四下无人从警卫亭找到几个疫尸袋。我花了一些时间，总算把莫里斯装进其中一个袋子。至少他的脸被遮住了。

第十二条
小罗伯特也走了。我天空中的星星已经消失。

[页面丢失]

第十七条
埃利斯在半夜停止了呼吸。她是个如此倔强的女孩，我简直不敢相信她也被病魔压倒了。我切盲鳗或蔬菜时，她总是在旁边，为每件事和我争论。

第十八条
这是大风之月的第四天。我终于意识到，他们全都离我而去了。我实在无法让自己去叫计死员。

第十九条
现在我也发烧了。再也没有警卫会来这里了。

en:
Galvani,

The latest case should arrive within a week, containing all the components you need. Be careful with the white phosphorus. Can't have you getting phossy jaw like the tanners at the edge of the city, poor bastards. 

Sorry you have to practice in secret. The vivisectionist should be celebrated! Revered even! Cutting up rats should be done in the town square with a crowd of eager students taking notes, not in some dirty little secret room hidden behind a wall of books.  

Anyway, lucky for you to have an old friend who never left the Academy. Let me know what else you need, but remember it might be a month before I can put together another shipment.

Yours in knowledge,
Artemis Moore
Procurement Clerk and Provisioner
Academy of Natural Philosophy, South Wing 

P.S. Next time you're nearby, come in for an afternoon. We've stayed fairly insulated from the plague, since so few come and go here, and we've got quite the stock of Tyvian brandy.
old:
加尔瓦尼，

最新的补给箱将在一周之内送到，里面装有所有你需要的材料。请小心使用白磷。你这个可怜的混蛋，可不能像那些城市底层的皮匠一样感染磷毒性颌骨坏死病。

很遗憾但是你的实验必须秘密进行。活体实验者都应该被表彰！甚至应当受人尊敬！像解剖老鼠这种活就应该在市中心广场来干，旁边应该有一群热切的学生忙着记笔记，而不是在藏在书架后面的一个狭小肮脏的密室里。

无论如何，有我这个一直呆在学院的朋友帮忙总是件好事。如果你有什么别的需要，请一定告诉我，但是记住我可能在一个月后才能再次发货。

知识与你同在，
阿蒂米斯·摩尔
采购主任与后勤保障管理员
自然哲学学院，南翼

备注：你下次路过的时候记得进来坐坐。因为鼠疫，我们已经很久没见面了，导致我这里的提维亚白兰地储量都快过剩了。
new:
加尔瓦尼，

最新的补给箱将在一周之内送到，里面装有你需要的所有材料。请小心使用白磷。可不能让你像城郊那些可怜的制革工一样患上磷毒性颌骨坏死。

很遗憾，你不得不秘密进行实验。活体解剖者理应受到表彰！甚至应当受人敬仰！解剖老鼠这种事就该在市中心广场进行，让一群热切的学生在旁边记笔记，而不是躲在书墙后面那个狭小肮脏的密室里。

无论如何，幸好你还有我这个一直留在学院的老朋友。如果你还有别的需要，请告诉我，但要记住，我可能得过一个月才能备好下一批货物。

知识与你同在，
阿蒂米斯·摩尔
采购主任与后勤保障管理员
自然科学院，南翼

备注：下次你到附近时，进来坐一下午吧。这里出入的人很少，所以我们基本没受到鼠疫侵扰，而且还存了相当多的提维亚白兰地。
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把“可怜的制革工”错指为加尔瓦尼本人，并将学院因人员出入少而避开鼠疫、存有白兰地的内容改成两人久未见面；同时修正自然科学院术语。

en:
Dear Ms. Benton,

When cleaning my study, I ask that you constrain your efforts strictly to the floors. Please, at all costs refrain from attempting to clean or arrange my bookshelf. In fact, it would be best to keep away from it altogether. Otherwise, I'll have to reconsider the terms of your employment.

Regards,
Dr. Galvani

P.S. Since I'll be out of the city for a few days, I've left next week's pay as well. The bank was closed, so I'm afraid it's short by half. You can count on me for the remainder next week of course.
old:
亲爱的本顿女士，

当你打扫我的书房的时候，我恳请你只要把地板弄干净就行了。再次恳请你，千万不要试图去清洁或整理我的书柜。事实上，只要不去管它就是最好的了。否则，我将会重新考虑与你的续约问题。

此致，
加尔瓦尼医生

备注：因为我将会去城外呆几天，所以我已经把下周的工钱一起付了。但由于银行已经关门了，可能有一部分还没有到账。不过，你可以相信我一定会在下周给你补全的。

en: I've been invited to a soiree at the Boyle Estate. Of course, I won't attend. The 28th day of the 7th month, the Month of High Cold, is the day I met Anton Sokolov at the Academy. Why would I tarnish the anniversary of the most important day of my life by licking aristocratic boots?  I have no time for fools. I will be solving the riddle of this plague.\n\nPerhaps I'll raise a cup of Tyvian red.
old: 我被邀请前去参加波义耳宅邸的社交晚会。我当然不会去的。第七个月份，结冰之月的28日，我将会去学院拜访安东·索科洛夫。为什么我要去舔那些贵族的鞋，以此玷污我一生中最重要的纪念时刻呢？我可不想在蠢人身上浪费时间。我可是即将要解决这场鼠疫的人。\n\n也许我该喝一杯提维亚红酒了。

en: This is it, by the Outsider's eyes. I've been fighting the fever for a few nights now, since those damn Bottle Street hooligans kept me pinned down and I couldn't get to my elixir stash. All I wanted to do was lay low, run my little shop and ride out the plague. Dunwall was a good place before all this mess with death of the Empress, the plague, and the Lord Regent's new laws. If you find this, maybe you'll have better luck than I did. And if Slackjaw or any of you Bottle Street idiots are reading this, I hope the City Watch guts you all. \n\n--Griff
old: 界外魔作证，它终于来了。那些该死的瓶街帮混蛋把我困在这里，我无法前去我的秘密药水仓库，而我已经和高烧斗争了好几个晚上了。现在我只想好好经营我的小店，撑过这场鼠疫，或者立刻被杀死。顿沃曾经是天堂，直到发生那些乱七八糟的事情，女皇的死、鼠疫、摄政王的新政。如果你找到了这封信，你的运气或许比我好点。不过如果大嘴巴或者其他瓶街白痴正在看这封信，我希望警卫把你们的的肠子全都拽出来。\n\n--格里夫
new: 界外魔之眼作证，这下完了。那些该死的瓶街帮混混一直把我困在这里，害我拿不到储藏的药剂，而我已经和高烧斗争好几个晚上了。我只想低调躲着，经营自己的小店，熬过这场鼠疫。女皇之死、鼠疫以及摄政王的新法令把一切搅乱之前，顿沃原本是个好地方。如果你找到了这封信，或许你的运气会比我好些。如果大嘴巴或者任何一个瓶街帮白痴正在看这封信，我希望城市警卫把你们全都开膛破肚。\n\n--格里夫

en:

en:
This place reeked of the Outsider. Not since our sweeps of Rudshore, the Flooded District, have I seen such blasphemy. 

Overseer Marcus has inventoried the evidence of heresy that we collected. A number of questionable books, several jars containing the heads and viscera of animals, and a shrine dedicated to the black arts. 

I've remained behind to examine a few more things. Even spending the night here has crossed my mind. It's an unnerving thought, but it may prove useful to remind myself of what the Abbey of the Everyman stands for, and the sacrosanct duty we've taken on, as Overseers.

--Overseer Warren
old:
这个地方到处散发着界外魔的臭气。在我们来清理赭岸水淹区之前，我还从未见过这样的亵秽。

督军马卡斯记录下了我们收集的每一条异端证据。一堆可疑的书，几个装有动物的头和内脏的瓶子，以及一个用于黑魔法的祭坛。

我仍留在这里以收集更多证据。为此我甚至曾经想过在这里留宿一晚。这真是个可怕的想法，但是这样可能有助于我理解什么才是众生修道院的宗旨，以及为何我们作为督军的职责神圣不可侵犯。

--督军瓦伦
new:
这个地方到处散发着界外魔的臭气。自从我们清剿赭岸的水淹区以来，我还从未见过这样的亵渎。

督军马卡斯记录下了我们收集的异端证据：一批可疑的书、几个装着动物头颅和内脏的罐子，以及一座供奉黑魔法的祭坛。

我仍留在这里检查另外几样东西。我甚至考虑过在这里过夜。这个念头令人不安，但或许能提醒我众生修道院为何而立，也能提醒我身为督军所肩负的神圣职责。

--督军瓦伦

1 part Sokolov's elixir

2 parts sugar water

Slackjaw

大嘴巴

Mister Bunting,
 
I know you've been waiting for the Golden Cat to re-open. You've probably been suffering, you poor dear. So let me offer you a warm welcome to our lavish reopening tomorrow. I assure you that everything has been cleaned up, top to bottom, after that touch of plague. We're ready to take care of you. 

Everyone here loves you and half the girls consider you a friend.

--Madame Prudence

Lord Regent,
It's undoubtedly not worth your time and I hesitate to even mention it, but apparently on the night of the Boyle Party someone signed the guestbook as "Corvo Attano". It must be a perverse joke, surely. However, you asked to be notified of all such matters, and in truth we never located the Royal Protector's body, so I thought it best to bring it to your attention. Sorry for troubling you with this matter. I know Lady Boyle was dear to you. 

Captain Galloway

en:
General Tobias, I have to press you again, sir. The torturer has been coming into the barracks at night. 

Last night Corporal Huso woke up to find the freak leering at him in the dark. Other men have reported that personal items have gone missing, with odd things left in their place. Sanders said he found a bunch of teeth wrapped up in his handkerchief. Teeth. And Bilson found three painted rat-heads on a string in his shaving kit. 

Whatever this is, it has to stop. The men are rattled and I don't know how long I can keep them from going into that bastard's room and beating him to death in his sleep. I don't care what you call him, executioner, torturer, Royal Interrogator or bat-faced troll, he's got to stay out of the barracks.

--First Commander Greggory
old:
托比亚斯将军，我不得不再提醒你一次，先生。拷问者在夜里跑到了军营里。

昨天夜里胡索下士醒来，发现在黑暗中有个怪物正盯着他。其他的士兵也报告说有些私人物品不见了，但却又多出了一些奇形怪状的东西。桑德斯说他打开手帕发现了一捆牙齿。而比尔森说在他的剃须用品上发现了三个排列成串的涂色老鼠脑袋。

不管这些意味着什么，必须将它们立刻取缔。士兵们的意见很大，我不知道我还能维持多久，以不让他们冲进那个混蛋的房间并在他睡觉的时候把他打死。我不管你们如何称呼他，行刑者也好，拷问者也好，皇家审讯官也好，或者蝙蝠脸的巨魔也好，他必须给我滚出军营

--首席司令官格雷戈里
new:
托比亚斯将军，我不得不再次向您提出这件事，先生。拷问者一直在夜里跑进军营。

昨天夜里胡索下士醒来，发现那个怪胎正在黑暗中盯着他。其他士兵也报告说有些私人物品不见了，原处却留下了一些古怪的东西。桑德斯说他在自己的手帕里发现了一把包起来的牙齿。牙齿。而比尔森说在他的剃须用具中发现了一根绳子，上面串着三个涂过颜色的老鼠脑袋。

不管这究竟是怎么回事，都必须停止。士兵们已经心神不宁，我不知道还能阻止他们多久，不让他们冲进那个混蛋的房间，趁他熟睡时把他活活打死。我不管你们如何称呼他，行刑者也好，拷问者也好，皇家审讯官也好，或者蝙蝠脸的巨魔也好，他必须远离军营。

--首席司令官格雷戈里

en:
Brother, 

With an anxious heart, I respond to your letter. If your suspicion is true, I have grave misgivings about those presiding over Dunwall Tower. I have only recently resolved my disagreements with the Abbey, and it has come upon me as a surprise that some are lobbying for me to take up the mantle of High Overseer, but despite all that is going on, I hope to advise you personally in this matter. 

Last time you wrote, you speculated that the mute who serves as torturer within Dunwall Tower might be a follower of the Outsider. He has an odd countenance, his tongue is twisted and he cannot speak, and a wolfhound follows him about. Add to this the incomprehensible groaning and the litany of repeated whispers you hear coming from his chambers at night and it seems certain. 

At first I found it hard to believe. How could one I admire so, such as the Lord Regent, allow this to go unchecked within his own house? Surely he must respect the Seven Strictures? But now I see the pieces arranged before me. I must tell you, it aligns with a vision experienced by one of our sisters from the Oracular Sect. Coming to me in the night, she spoke, "Silence inflicts pain and a hound's shadow follows the puppet of the Outsider." 

Your position at the Tower has been of great use to our order and there is no shame in reporting back to me. You are an Overseer, first and foremost, and it is your sole duty to protect the world of men from the malevolent influences of the Outsider. Tell no others of this and await my instructions. I must wonder how high up into Dunwall Tower this corruption has spread.

--Martin
old:
兄弟，

接到你的来信后，我迫不及待地要回你一封。如果你的怀疑是真的，我之前对顿沃高塔的统治者的疑虑就没有错了。我最近解决了我与修道院的分歧，而让我很惊讶的是居然有人来劝我去当至高督军，但是除去我这里的事情不谈，我希望就以下这事给你一些私人的建议。

在你的上一封信中，你推测说那个在顿沃城被称为拷问者的哑子会成为界外魔的追随者。他的长相非常奇怪，他的舌头被绞掉了所以他不能说话，并且一直有只猎犬跟着他。再加上夜里从他的房间发出的神秘的呻吟和一连串重复的低语，有关界外魔一事看来是确定了。

最初我认为这简直无法相信。我如此敬佩的摄政王怎么会允许这种人随意进出他的房子？首先他必须遵守七约令吧？但是且看我面前的这些资料。我必须告诉你，这与我们在神谕部门的姐妹所经历的事情十分相似。她昨晚来到我这，说：“音缄声无，无语徒增痛苦。恶犬袭影，影随界外儡兵。” 

你在顿沃高塔的职位可以为我们的任务提供极大的便利，而且你也可以光明正大地向我汇报情况。最首要的是，你是个督军，而你的唯一的使命就是从界外魔邪恶的影响中保护这个世界。这件事先不要告诉别人，请等待我的指令。我必须搞清楚顿沃高塔中的腐坏已经到达了何种程度。

--马丁
new:
兄弟，

怀着不安的心情，我回复你的来信。如果你的怀疑是真的，我对那些掌管顿沃高塔的人深感不安。我最近才解决了与修道院的分歧，竟有人游说我接过至高督军的衣钵，这着实令我惊讶；但尽管眼下诸事纷扰，我仍希望亲自就此事给你建议。

在你的上一封信中，你推测说那个在顿沃高塔担任拷问者的哑巴可能是界外魔的追随者。他面容古怪，舌头扭曲而无法说话，还有一只猎狼犬始终跟着他。再加上夜里从他的房间传出的费解呻吟和反复低语，看来此事已可确定。

最初我觉得难以置信。像摄政王这样令我钦佩的人，怎么会允许这种事在自己的府邸中不受管束？他理应尊重七约令才是。但如今，所有线索都已摆在我的面前。我必须告诉你，这与我们神谕教派的一位姐妹所见的异象相符。她夜里来见我并说道：“沉默施加痛苦，猎犬的影子追随着界外魔的傀儡。”

你在顿沃高塔的职位对我们的教团大有用处，向我汇报并不可耻。最首要的是，你是一名督军，而你唯一的职责就是保护人类世界免受界外魔邪恶力量的影响。不要把这件事告诉任何人，等待我的指令。我不得不怀疑，这种腐化已经蔓延到了顿沃高塔的多高层级。

--马丁

new: 又一个主顾死了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在我们该怎么办？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 后文说明说话者受人雇用且对方支付报酬，因此 patron 指其主顾或雇主，而非提供资助的“赞助人”。仅修正该对象类型。

en: Never doubt it.
old: 绝对的。
new: 绝对没错。
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“绝对的”是明显生硬的直译；Never doubt it 表示对此绝不要怀疑、肯定没错。

en: Oh, didn't I tell you Arnold?  The Kruller case went swimmingly.  All the right parties were exonerated.  You'll see the results on your ledger early next week.
old: 哦，<XXXX/> 我没告诉过阿诺德你吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 克鲁勒案进展地很顺利。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 所有的当权人都被免除了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 下周你就能在你的分类账上看到结果了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 哦，<XXXX/> 我没告诉过你吗，阿诺德？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 克鲁勒案进展得很顺利。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 该脱罪的各方都洗清了罪名。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 下周初你就能在账本上看到结果了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将 Arnold 的呼语位置译乱；exonerated 是洗清罪名，并非“被免除”；early next week 的“下周初”也被遗漏。

en: His forces were utterly destroyed. Any survivors have fled.
old: 他的力量已经完全被摧毁了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有幸存者的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们肯定已经跑了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他的部队已经全军覆没。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 若有幸存者，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也都已经逃走了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: forces 在此指其武装力量或部队，译成抽象的“力量”明显失准；同时去除原文没有的推测语气。

en: Oh, yeah? How so?
old: 哦，是吗？怎么犯？
new: 哦，是吗？怎么说？
reason: 人工裁决: “How so?”是在追问“怎么会、怎么说”，原译“怎么犯”明显错误。

en: Who's that? Somebody with a little clink in their purse, perhaps?
old: 是谁？<XXXXXX/> 是某人荷包里零钱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 大概吧？<XXXXXXXX/>
new: 是谁？<XXXXXX/> 是个荷包里有几个响钱的家伙，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 大概吧？<XXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“是某人荷包里零钱”缺少谓语且句法不成立；原文是在猜来者的钱袋里或许有钱。

en: This meeting is taking far too long. We should go in and tell Curnow there's important business. Get him out of Campbell's clutches.
old: 这会开得真够久。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们应该进去告诉科纳，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有些重要的事务需要处理。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 让他离开坎贝尔的地盘。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这会开得真够久。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们应该进去告诉科纳，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有些重要的事务需要处理。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 让他摆脱坎贝尔的控制。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Campbell's clutches 指坎贝尔的控制或掌握，原译“坎贝尔的地盘”语义错误。

en: The doom of Pandyssia has come to the city.
old: 潘迪希恩的末日已经降临了这座城市。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 来自潘迪希恩的灾祸已经降临了这座城市。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Wiki 证据明确指出此处指源自潘迪希恩、降临顿沃的鼠疫灾祸；当前候选消除了“潘迪希恩自身的末日”这一误读，应采用当前修补版。

en: Hmph.
old: 嗯。
new: 哼。
reason: 人工裁决: 修正天邈原译。英文“Hmph”通常表示不满、不屑或怀疑的鼻音，不是表示应答的“嗯”；“哼”适用于该共享 AI 语音的触发范围。

en: It's a hard thing, holding the keys to the Empire in your hands. It weighs on a man's mind, heavily.
old: 这事很艰难，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 把帝国的关键掌握在自己手上真的很难。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这对人类精神的负担太大了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 太沉重了。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这事很艰难，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 把帝国的大权掌握在自己手中。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这会沉重地压在一个人的心头，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 无比沉重。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: keys to the Empire 比喻掌握帝国大权，并非“帝国的关键”；weighs on a man's mind 指沉重的心理压力，原译“人类精神”语义生硬。

en: I'm better than any of these fools.
old: 我比任何一个这些白痴都强。
new: 我比这些白痴中的任何一个都强。
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“任何一个这些白痴”语序明显不合中文习惯，属于生硬直译。

en: She had her jobber pick up a boy in the street, barely sixteen years old, no family left.
old: 她收留了个差不多十六岁的男孩，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 是个孤儿。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 她让手下从街上弄来一个才十六岁左右的男孩，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 已经没有家人了。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Medium 已补回让手下从街上带来男孩这一关键行为，并准确保留其年龄及没有家人的信息。

en: I should probably tag along when you go. Crazy rich people are buying up a lot of that Sokolov security technology these days. Keeps the weepers and looters out. I might be useful.
old: 你走的时候，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也许我应当跟着你。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这年头，<XXXXXXXX/> 富人们正疯狂购买那种索科洛夫的安保技术，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 以阻挡恸哭者和掠夺者。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也许能帮上忙的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你走的时候，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也许我应当跟着你。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这年头，<XXXXXXXX/> 那些富得离谱的人正在大量购买索科洛夫的那种安保技术，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 以阻挡恸哭者和掠夺者。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也许能帮上忙的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “crazy rich”修饰富裕程度，而原译误成富人“疯狂购买”；改为“富得离谱”并对应“buying up a lot”的“大量购买”。

en: Sorry, not yet. I was gonna report that boiler leak from yesterday.
old: 还没。<XXXXXX/> 我刚准备去报告昨天的锅炉泄露事件。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 抱歉，还没。<XXXXXX/> 我刚准备去报告昨天的锅炉泄漏。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译漏掉“Sorry”，且“锅炉泄露”用词错误，应为液体或气体“泄漏”。

en: Yeah. I'll bet Lord Ramsey is doing a dance. He oughta be at that fancy Boyle party tonight, bragging to all his rich friends.
old: 听说了。<XXXXXXXX/> 我肯定拉姆齐勋爵现在正跳舞呢。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他今晚应该要出席那个花哨的波义尔晚宴，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在那儿向他所有有钱的朋友吹牛皮。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 听说了。<XXXXXXXX/> 我肯定拉姆齐勋爵现在正跳舞呢。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他今晚应该会去参加波义耳的派对——那场排场十足的晚宴，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在那儿向他所有有钱的朋友吹牛皮。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 此处确指特定的波义耳派对；当前译文正确统一了姓氏及事件名称，并以同位说明保留了 fancy 的含义。

en: The smell of this place... Even with this mask on...
old: 这个地方的味道......就算带着面具也......
new: 这个地方的味道......就算戴着面具也......
reason: 人工裁决: 面具应当用“戴”，原译“带着面具”用字错误。

en: Someone's about to get shanked.
old: 有人就要受伤了。
new: 有人就要挨刀了。
reason: 人工裁决: “shanked”明确指遭刀刺，原译仅作“受伤”遗漏了关键的持刀袭击信息。

en: I hope the bed's to your liking. Let me know if you have trouble sleeping.
old: 我希望这床符合您的喜好。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 让我了解您是否还睡得踏实。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我希望这床符合您的喜好。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果您睡不踏实，请告诉我。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“是否还睡得踏实”与“if you have trouble sleeping”含义相反。

en: I didn't say that, exactly. They are simply different institutions.
old: 我确实没有这么说过。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们只是属于不同的体系。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我没完全这么说。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 它们只是不同的机构。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “I didn't say that, exactly”意为所说并非完全如此，原译“确实没有这么说过”把保留意味改成了完全否认；institutions也应指机构而非人物。

en: Of course. If your sister pleases us, then her death can be swift.  But if she resists, then her agony will be legendary.
old: 当然，<XXXXXX/> 要是你妹妹能让我们找点乐子，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她就可以死的痛快点。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 要是她抵抗的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她死前的挣扎就能能在火刑史上记上一笔了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 当然，<XXXXXX/> 要是你妹妹能让我们满意，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她就可以死得痛快点。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 要是她抵抗的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她所受的折磨将成为传奇。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译擅自加入“找点乐子”和“火刑史”，并把“agony”偏移为“死前挣扎”，另有“能能”错字；修补为英文明确表达的满意、迅速死亡与传奇般折磨。

en: The youngest of the Boyle women. She suffers from reckless frivolity, followed by long bouts of melancholy.
old: 最年轻的波义耳女士。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她饱尝鲁莽草率带来的恶果，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 紧接着是长久而来的忧思哀愁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 最年轻的波义耳女士。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她时而肆意妄为、轻浮放纵，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 随后又会陷入漫长的忧郁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文描述她在轻浮放纵与长期忧郁两种状态间转换，原译误写成因鲁莽而承受恶果的因果关系。

en: Got anything to smoke or eat?
old: 收获什么可以用来吸烟的或者吃的东西吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 有烟抽或有东西吃吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“收获什么可以……”句式生硬且误加“收获”之意；修正为询问是否有烟或食物。

en: A man sees funny things out at sea. The world's not all like the Overseers teach it. Not by a long shot.
old: 一个人在出海时看到了有趣的事。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这个世界一点也不像督军们所教授的那样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 绝不是那样。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 人在海上会见到稀奇古怪的东西。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这个世界一点也不像督军们所教授的那样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 绝不是那样。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Medium 正确恢复了泛指语气和海上见到怪事的含义，避免了旧译所引入的特定人物、过去时及“有趣”之义；其余部分未作无依据扩写。

en: This one has kept a lock of hair from everyone he's ever killed.
old: 这家伙收藏着所有被他杀死的人的头发。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这家伙收藏着每一个被他杀死的人的一绺头发。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文明确是从每名死者身上保留“一绺头发”，旧译漏掉数量单位，削弱了逐一收集战利品的含义。

en: In troubled times, fortune often favors those such as he.
old: 在动乱的时期，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 财富总会青睐他这样的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 在动乱的时期，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好运总会青睐他这样的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: fortune 此处指好运、时运，而非“财富”。

en: Yeah, come into reach!
old: 耶，过来呀！
new: 好啊，再靠近点！
reason: 人工裁决: 战斗挑衅中的 Yeah 不是欢呼的“耶”，come into reach 也明确要求对方进入攻击距离；当前译文遗漏了距离含义。

en: Restless hands do no good, they say.
old: 不懈之手带不来任何好处，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们是这么说的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 不安之手带不来任何好处，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们是这么说的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 此句是在引用七约令中的固定概念 Restless Hands，采用“不安之手”具有明确语境依据；改动仅修正旧译术语错误。

en: I'll be glad when we return to stalking aristocrats. They seldom send an army of Overseers to destroy us.
old: 当我们重新开始追猎贵族的时候我会很开心的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们从来都不知道派出督军来摧毁我们。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 当我们重新开始追猎贵族的时候我会很开心的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们很少会派出一整支督军军队来消灭我们。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: seldom send an army 意为“很少派出一整支军队”，旧译“从来都不知道派出”语义错误。

en: I had a flask in my studio. Had I known I'd be leaving I would have grabbed it.
old: 在我的工作室里有一壶。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 早知道我就把它带来了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我的工作室里有一瓶酒。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 早知道要离开，我就把它带上了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“一壶”缺少中心语，并遗漏了“Had I known I'd be leaving”中的离开之意。

en: This place is barely adequate. One day, because of your efforts, I'll have a vast laboratory in Dunvall Tower.
old: 这个地方勉强足够。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 总有一天，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你将会因为你的努力在顿沃高塔拥有一个实验室。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这个地方勉强够用。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 总有一天，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 因为你的努力，我会在顿沃高塔拥有一座巨大的实验室。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文主语是“我”，即皮耶罗将因玩家的努力拥有实验室；原译错成玩家将拥有实验室，并遗漏“vast”。

en: Don't look at me.  I don't get paid enough for this.
old: 别看我。我得到的还不够呢。
new: 别看我。干这事给我的钱可不够。
reason: 人工裁决: I don't get paid enough for this 指薪酬不足以让自己处理此事；原译漏掉“为这件事拿报酬”的关键语义。

en: Lizzy's boat is smaller than I remember.
old: 莉齐的船比我印象中的变小了些。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 莉齐的船比我印象中小了些。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 英文是在将船的大小与记忆作比较；“变小了些”会误成船本身发生了缩小。

en: Now your choices interest me. You spared High Overseer Campbell, the leader of a great cult dedicated to loathing me. I'm older than the rocks this place is built on, and even I didn't see that coming.
old: 现在你的选择让我倍感兴趣。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你饶恕了至高督军坎贝尔，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那让我恶心的狂热者领袖。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我比这里的岩石更加古老，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但是我却没有遇见到这些。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 现在你的选择让我倍感兴趣。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你饶恕了至高督军坎贝尔，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 一个一心憎恨我的庞大教团的领袖。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我比建造此地的岩石还要古老，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 可就连我也没料到会这样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译颠倒了教团对界外魔的憎恨关系，并将“没料到会这样”错译成“没有遇见到这些”。

en: Don't think I'm on your side, because I'm not. If you raise a hand to any of my sisters but Delilah, you'll answer to me.
old: 不要以为我站在你这一边，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 因为我没有。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果你对黛莉拉之外的我的任何一个姐妹出手的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你将受到我的制裁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 不要以为我站在你这一边，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 因为我不是。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果你对除黛莉拉以外的任何一个姐妹出手，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你将受到我的制裁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “because I'm not”误译为“因为我没有”，且“黛莉拉之外的我的任何一个姐妹”语序生硬；修正判断句和语序。

en: You nearly destroyed this city. No amount of money will undo that.
old: 你差点就摧毁了这座城市。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 无论多少钱也不能抵消你的罪行。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你差点就摧毁了这座城市。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 无论多少钱也无法挽回这一切。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: that 回指差点毁城造成的后果；“抵消你的罪行”把不可挽回的事实改成了抵消罪责，金钱所针对的对象发生偏移。

en: One of their prisoners. A spy caught at Dunwall Tower. The guards have sent for Overseers to investigate.
old: 那是其中的一名囚犯，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在顿沃高塔被抓获的间谍。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 守卫已经派督军前去调查了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 那是他们的一名囚犯，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 一个在顿沃高塔被抓获的间谍。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 守卫已经派人去请督军来调查了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “sent for Overseers”是守卫派人请督军前来，原译成守卫派遣督军，颠倒了双方关系。

en: You're lucky I keep you on.
old: 你该庆幸我救了你。
new: 你该庆幸我还没开除你。
reason: 人工裁决: keep you on 指继续留用、没有开除，不是“救了你”。

en: Yes, sir.  I'll just...relax. Have a drink, maybe. It could be a long night.
old: 是，<XXXX/> 先生。<XXXXXX/> 我只是在......放松。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 喝一杯，<XXXXXXXX/> 也许吧。<XXXXXXXX/> 今晚可能会很漫长的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 是，<XXXX/> 先生。<XXXXXX/> 我就......放松一下。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 喝一杯，<XXXXXXXX/> 也许吧。<XXXXXXXX/> 今晚可能会很漫长的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: There's hardly a need to work on table etiquette. She knows it all, even if she choses not to employ it. She'd rather hold her spoon by the wrong end and pretend it's a sword. Then, suddenly, she changes and she's all manners, asking for a tea party. I tried to oblige her, but I have little to work with, no proper plates. Instead of a cloth napkin I've only the bar rag. Ale mugs, instead of teacups. I've asked for things befitting her, but they have their minds on other things. For now, Emily and I decided to make a pretend dinner setting using paper, and little things she's found here and there - on the floor I suppose. Not right for a princess, but it'll have to do.

en: Emily, my daughter, I know that one day you'll be grown up, and I wonder what you'll remember of these years. Will you recall your time as a child with fondness? Or were there too many caretakers, formal dinners and lessons about boring old history? Maybe the precious hours we spent together will shine brighter; time captured now and then with your mother and with Corvo, who was always close to my heart. I hope the season of rats and plague will be nothing more than a passing shadow on your early memories. A crisis come and passed, weathered by your mother and her advisors. You'll sit on the throne someday, and will do well I hope. It's a tricky life, full of responsibility and peril. It was not your choice to be the daughter of an Empress, but I believe you'll rise to the challenge. Stay good-hearted, Emily. Keep drawing and telling stories. And only share your power with those you truly trust.

en: The Eels are lucky Geezer knows how to make a bargain.

new: 死鳗帮很幸运，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 倔老头知道怎么做交易。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 已裁决的研究结论确认“The Eels”是 Dead Eels 帮派的简称；“那群鳗鱼”误译为动物，须最小修正为标准名称“死鳗帮”。

en: At the Academy, they cut the flesh of the dead, and trap the lightning from the sky.
old: 在学院，<XXXXXXXX/> 他们从死人身上切下肉块，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 以此诱导天上的闪电。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 在学院，<XXXXXXXX/> 他们切开死者的肉体，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 并捕获天空中的闪电。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 英文并列描述解剖死者与捕获闪电两件事；原译“以此诱导”错误添加了因果关系。

en: Attention Dunwall Citizens: Do not attempt to interfere with the regular transfer of deceased persons to disposal centers in the Flooded District.
old: 顿沃城市民请注意：请勿试图干涉将死者送往水淹区中心的定期运输。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 顿沃城市民请注意：请勿试图干涉将死者定期运往水淹区处理中心的工作。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把 disposal centers in the Flooded District 误成“水淹区中心”，遗漏“处理中心”的含义。

en: I've come to break you out. You can owe me the favor.
old: 我是来帮助你越狱的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你可以认为是欠我一个人情。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我是来帮助你越狱的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你欠我一个人情就行。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: favor 在此是越狱相助所形成的“人情”，当前没有机械套用术语；“你欠我一个人情就行”也修复了原译不自然且弱化关系的表述。

en: I'll sniff you out you little bilge rat.
old: 我会把你找出来的，小仓鼠。
new: 我会把你嗅出来的，你这只舱底小耗子。
reason: 人工裁决: “bilge rat”是带有航海色彩的“舱底鼠”辱称，并非仓鼠；同时保留“sniff out”的嗅出意味。

en: For the love of Dunwall!! How?! How did you get to me?! No, it's impossible! An hallucination! My eyes see what they fear!
old: 看在顿沃的份上！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/> 怎么可能？<XXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/> 你是怎样接近我的？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/> 不，<XXXX/> 这不可能！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 一定是幻觉！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我的眼睛看到了他们害怕的事情！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 看在顿沃的份上！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/> 怎么可能？<XXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/> 你是怎样接近我的？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/> 不，<XXXX/> 这不可能！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 一定是幻觉！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我的双眼看到了令它们恐惧的景象！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “they”指代复数的“my eyes”，原译“他们”指代错误。

en: You better throw that switch again! If you leave me alive in this chair I'll be comin' after you! You hear me? I'll see you flayed alive!
old: 你最好再扳那开关一次！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 要是你让我从这把椅子上活着下来的话我一定会去找你算账的！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你听见了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我要亲眼看见你被生生扒皮！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你最好再扳那开关一次！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 要是你让我活着留在这把椅子上，我一定会找你算账！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你听见了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我要亲眼看见你被生生扒皮！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: leave me alive in this chair 指让他说话者活着留在椅子上，旧译误成让他从椅子上活着下来。

en: One. Two. Three. Heave!
old: 一、二、三。丢！
new: 一、二、三。用力！
reason: 人工裁决: “Heave”是多人协力搬、拉或抛掷时的发力号子，原译“丢”无依据地限定了具体动作；“用力”可安全覆盖所有已知动作可能。

en: Have you seen me wife? Dark hair, 'bout this tall. Name of Sarah?
old: 你看见我的妻子了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 黑头发，<XXXXXXXX/> 大概这么高。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她叫莎朗。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你看见我的妻子了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 黑头发，<XXXXXXXX/> 大概这么高。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她叫莎拉。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 英文姓名为 Sarah，原译“莎朗”对应 Sharon，属于明确的人名错译。

en: They went off. Just a little while ago.
old: 它们流出来了，就刚刚。
new: 它们启动了，就在刚才。
reason: 人工裁决: 结合前文的毒气陷阱，went off 指陷阱刚刚启动或触发；当前译文修正了将陷阱本身说成“流出来”的实物类型错误。

en: Where'd he go so quick?
old: 他这么快要去哪里？
new: 他怎么一下就不见了？
reason: 人工裁决: Where'd he go 描述目标突然消失，当前译文准确修复了原译误用将来去向的问题。

en: Then what are we waitin' for?  Let's go kill us some of the watch!  An eye for an eye!
old: 那咱们还等什么？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 为了自己咱们杀几个警卫去！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 以眼还眼！<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 那咱们还等什么？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 咱们去杀几个警卫！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 以眼还眼！<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “kill us some of the watch”是去杀几个警卫，原译凭空加入“为了自己”。

en: You're not Lord Pendelton.  Get off the property.  Now.
old: 你不是潘德顿勋爵，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 放下我的东西，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 就现在。<XXXXXXXX/>
new: 你不是潘德顿勋爵，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 离开这处宅邸，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 立刻。<XXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Get off the property”是命令对方离开宅邸，原译“放下我的东西”属于明显错译。

en: If there were work on the ships, there would be fewer men volunteering for the City Watch.
old: 如果这儿的工作是在船上，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那么会有更少人志愿加入城市警卫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 如果船上有活可干，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 自愿加入城市警卫的人就会少一些。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Claims he overheard one of the others talking, planning an escape. Started shouting for the guards.
old: 他坦白到他无意中听见其他人在谈论计划出逃的事情，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 于是便开始大声呼唤警卫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他声称自己无意中听见另一个囚犯谈论越狱计划，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 于是便开始大声呼唤警卫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Claims 是“声称”而非“坦白”；one of the others 是其他人中的一个，原译还误成了复数泛指。

en: The Heretic's Brand! Is that mercy, I wonder, or just a more refined sadism? Don't answer. Leave Campbell's unconscious body in the hound cage marked "E," and I'll give him the mark myself.
old: 异教烙印！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 这算不算是仁慈，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不知道，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 或者是更加残忍吧？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 别想了。<XXXXXXXX/> 把昏迷的坎贝尔留在狗舍的E号笼，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我会亲自给他标记的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 异教烙印！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 这算不算是仁慈，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也说不准，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 还是只是一种更精致的施虐手段？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 别回答。<XXXXXXXX/> 把昏迷的坎贝尔留在标着“E”的狗笼里，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我会亲自给他烙上印记。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将“Don't answer”错成“别想了”，并将“more refined sadism”弱化为“更加残忍”；同时补回狗笼标有“E”的关系。

en: How dare you! I am calm! It's imperitive everything is locked and secure and in its proper place!
old: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我当然很冷静！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们必须封锁所有地方保证安全，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 并让他们各司其职。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你怎么敢这样跟我说话！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我当然很冷静！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 最要紧的是所有东西都要锁好并确保安全，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而且各归其位。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 英文中的“everything”指所有物件或设施，原译“让他们各司其职”误译为人员各守岗位。

en: I've got all your names. Morgan and Taylor and Cooper and Welkins and Linden. They'll go into a signed notarized deposition. I've sent word to the Lord Regent's office.

new: 我已经知道了你们所有人的名字。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 摩根、泰勒、考玻尔、威金斯以及林登。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这些名字会写进一份签字公证的证词里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我已经传话给摄政王办公室了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Who opened this cell? I better check.

old: 我已经有一张计时卡了。
new: 我已经有一张上班卡了。

en: There was rioting in the Tailor's District last night. The people demanding food, elixir against the plague and better treatment. Stilt walker guards set some of them on fire.
old: 昨晚在纺织区发生了骚乱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 人们索要食物，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对抗鼠疫的灵药和更好的治疗。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 高脚战士把其中几个人点上了火。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 昨晚在纺织区发生了骚乱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 人们索要食物，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对抗鼠疫的灵药和更好的待遇。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 高脚战士把其中几个人点上了火。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “better treatment”在民众诉求中指更好的待遇，Medium 对此修正正确；但将可接受的“点上了火”另改为“点着了”只是风格润色，故以原译为底稿仅保留必要修补。

en: Sir? Earlier I spotted crates bound for the most remote corner of the Empire. Might be worth stuffing him in one, just to tie things off. He doesn't seem the type to forgive.
old: 先生？<XXXXXX/> 早些时候，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我发现了运往帝国最偏远地区的板条箱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也许把他塞进去，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 用来稳固货物还不错。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他可不像个懂得原谅的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 先生？<XXXXXX/> 早些时候，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我发现了一些要运往帝国最偏远角落的板条箱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也许可以把他塞进其中一个，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 彻底了结这件事。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他不像是会原谅人的那种人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: tie things off 意为彻底了结此事，原译“用来稳固货物”属于明显错译。

en: Martin will talk him out, twist his head with words. Trust an Overseer for that.
old: 马丁会和他好好谈谈，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 用语言扭曲他的思想。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在这点上要信任督军的能力。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 马丁会劝他出来，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 用语言扭曲他的思想。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在这点上要信任督军的能力。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Emergency grain rations will be available in the Civil Services District at sunrise. Please see your tax assessor to secure food coupons before requesting rations.

new: 公务事务区将在黎明时分开始提供应急谷物配给。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 请在申请领取配给前先找你的估税员取得食品券。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将 grain rations 泛化为“食品”，遗漏谷物配给这一关键信息；同时明确食品券须在申请配给前取得。

en: Confound these machines. Someone fix this thing.
old: 这机器又坏了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 谁来修理修理它。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这些机器真该死。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 谁来把这东西修好。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Confound these machines”是在咒骂机器，并未说明机器“又坏了”；原译添加了原文没有的信息。

reason: 人工裁决: “the Eels”指死鳗帮，原译成字面意义的“那些鳗鱼”；同时“business”在此是事情而非交易。

en: I'll get to the bottom of this.
old: 我要把这弄个底朝天！
new: 我要把这事查个水落石出！
reason: 人工裁决: “get to the bottom of this”意为查明真相；原译“把这弄个底朝天”搭配错误，具有明显直译痕迹。

en: You've had a long night, Corvo. But I fear it's not over. Havelock and Martin have already cooked up something more for you. They would like to see you now. In Havelock's chambers above the bar.
old: 你渡过了一个漫长的夜晚，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 但恐怕这还没有结束。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 哈弗洛克和马丁已经为你准备好更多的计划。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们现在就想要见你。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 去哈弗洛克的寝室吧，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在酒吧的楼上。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你度过了一个漫长的夜晚，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 但恐怕这还没有结束。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 哈弗洛克和马丁已经为你准备好更多的计划。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们现在就想要见你。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 去哈弗洛克的寝室吧，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在酒吧的楼上。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: He won't. Will, you Corvo? You had your chance to be a hero. In a minute this will be just another bloody mess you left behind.

new: 他不会这么干的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你会吗，<XXXXXX/> 科尔沃？<XXXXXXXX/> 你曾有机会当个英雄。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 要不了多久这儿不过就是你留下的又一个血腥地狱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Take anything you find. I think I felt my heart skip.

en: Die, you little shit.

en: Ah, that reminds me... I must see Jerome about getting more Oxrush. I'm fresh out.

en: Corvo, my friend, the true killer of the empress is still out there, is he not?

new: 打开那该死的门！

en: What's gotten into you, by the Void!?

en: Corvo, here at last! After you and Havelock have met, I look forward to showing you my work. You might appreciate what I've done for you.

en: Waverly Boyle. She acts as if too good for her many suitors, but the servant boys know her well enough.

en: "They who put their trust in the Outsider, grasp at water. And drown!" Litany, fourth day verse eleven.

reason: 人工裁决: 原译将“grasp at water”改成了“没抓到救命稻草”，引入原文没有的意象；“fourth day”也被错译为“第四段”。

en: Some killer is the loose on the grounds.
old: 有些杀手在广场上开火。
new: 有个杀手在庭院里逃窜。
reason: 人工裁决: 原文表示一名杀手正在庭院中逍遥法外，原译“有些杀手在广场上开火”误译了数量与行为。

en: It'll be a rough trip. Used to be you'd go straight up Clavering Boulevard, but now it's not so easy. Half the city's dead of the plague, the other half's fighting over what's left.
old: 这会是场艰难的旅行。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 比起以前在克拉文鹰大道上的漫步要艰难地多。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 一半城市都因为瘟疫变得死寂了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而剩下的一半则为了剩下的互相征战。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这会是趟艰难的旅程。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 以前可以沿着克拉文鹰大道一直走上去，但现在没那么容易了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 城里一半的人都死于瘟疫，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 另一半则在争夺剩下的东西。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把过去可直接沿大道前进误成与昔日漫步作比较，并将半数人口死亡弱化成城市死寂。

en: You did it! Somehow you took down the High Overseer Campbell against the odds. I knew you were our man, Corvo. With Campbell gone, we've hurt the Lord Regent immeasurably. And with Martin back we'll have the finest strategist alive.
old: 你做到了！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你解决掉了至高督军坎贝尔。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我就知道你是我们的人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 现在坎贝尔不在，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 猎杀摄政王的可能性无限增大了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 并且随着马丁的归来，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们将与最具头脑的战略家一起并肩作战。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你做到了！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你排除万难解决掉了至高督军坎贝尔。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我就知道你是我们的人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 现在坎贝尔不在了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们给摄政王造成了无法估量的打击。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 并且随着马丁归来，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们将拥有世上最优秀的战略家。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将“重创摄政王”误成“猎杀摄政王的可能性增大”，并将“拥有最优秀的战略家”偏译成与其并肩作战。

en: Wouldn't it be a shame if some of that mess found its way into the Bottle Street gang's elixir still. That'd teach'em!

new: 要是那些脏东西有一些混进瓶街帮的生命药剂蒸馏桶里，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那可真遗憾。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这下能教训他们了！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文修复了“some of that mess”的严重误译；结合瓶街帮药剂生产语境，“生命药剂蒸馏桶”确指相应装置，未发生跨语境误套。

en: Keep moving. They'll be looking for you by now.

new: 继续走。<XXXXXX/> 他们现在应该已经在找你了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

reason: 人工裁决: 原译后两句语序生硬且存在明显机翻句式，修补后保留“洗牌”和四面受敌的原意。

en: Let's lay a few out. Striker's gotta hit one sooner or later.

en: If the pain gets any worse, I'll run at one of those wall of light checkpoints. Run right into it.

new: 要是疼得更厉害，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我就跑到那些检查点的光之壁那里去，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 直接冲进去。<XXXXXXXX/>

en: They walk about the plague, above the rats,  above the flooded streets.

en: Take it easy there, old son.

en: Good luck in there. Don't let them fool you. These people are rich, but they're cutthroats just the same.

new: 我们要检查每一个角落。

en: What? How much have I had today?

en: The infamous heretic Daud, taken out by the most clever Overseer Leonard Hume... Ha, I'll be in line for High Overseer when they see what I've done here!

new: 声名狼藉的异教徒道德，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 被最聪明的督军莱昂纳多·休姆干掉了......哈，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 等他们知道了我的功劳以后，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我肯定有望成为至高督军！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Shutup! Look at this stuff. Somebody's been down here.

en: I trust you're behaving yourself.
old: 我敢肯定你是在故作镇定。
new: 我想你会规规矩矩的。

en: Bit by bit, we're winning. Let's just hope the city lasts long enough for us to make things right again.

new: 我们正一点一点取得胜利。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但愿这座城市能够坚持到我们让一切恢复正轨。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: I told you to leave.

en: If you want my advice, head up these stairs.  You'll get a bird's eye view of the problem.  Might even see a solution.

new: 如果你想听我的建议，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 就顺着这些楼梯上去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你可以从高处看清问题所在。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 甚至还能发现解决办法。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

new: “举着这块牌子！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ”<XX/> “好的，<XXXXXXXX/> 为什么不呢？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> ”<XX/> “给你这份诉求清单！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ”<XX/> “听起来很有道理。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ”<XX/> 这就是我。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我就是这种人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: sign 被错译为“签名”，list of demands 也不是“需求列表”；末句指自己的性格，而非外貌。

en: Careful. The place may be boobytrapped, and I want him alive. What else?
old: 小心。<XXXXXX/> 这地方看起来像是个陷阱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 并且我要活捉他。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 还有什么问题吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 小心。<XXXXXX/> 这地方可能设有陷阱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而且我要活捉他。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 还有呢？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: boobytrapped 表示可能布有机关或陷阱，并非“看起来像是个陷阱”；What else? 是继续询问情况。

en: We'll go to the music room. We have an exquisite old harpsichord. Do you play?
old: 去音乐室吧，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们有一架精致的古钢琴，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你要弹弹吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 去音乐室吧，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们有一架精致的古老羽管键琴，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你要弹弹吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: harpsichord 是羽管键琴，并非“古钢琴”，属于物件错译。

en: Good job, idiot. You let him get away.
old: 干的真好啊，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 白痴，<XXXXXX/> 你让他跑了。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 干得真好啊，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 白痴，<XXXXXX/> 你让他跑了。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “干的真好”误用了结构助词，应为修饰动词“干”的“得”；仅修正错字并保留标签。

en: A haze surrounds them - I cannot see through it.
old: 迷雾笼罩着他们 - 我无法看穿他的内心。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 迷雾笼罩着他们 - 我无法看穿这片迷雾。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “I cannot see through it”中的“it”指迷雾；原译改成无法看穿某个男性的内心，指代和含义均有偏离。

en: Nice try, river rat. Get lost.
old: 不错的尝试，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你这河岸老鼠。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 滚吧。<XXXXXX/>
new: 想得美，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你这河岸老鼠。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 滚吧。<XXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Nice try”在拒绝对方时是讽刺性的“想得美”，原译有明显直译腔。

en: I'll need to check in with the gate guard.
old: 我需要去检查一下大门的守卫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我需要去向大门守卫报到。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “check in with the gate guard”指向守门警卫报到或接洽，不是去检查守卫；原译颠倒了动作关系。

en: Get in. We've got a hot meal and a warm bed waiting for you.
old: 上船吧，<XXXXXXXX/> 我们已经为你准备好了酒菜和床铺。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 上船吧，<XXXXXXXX/> 我们已经为你准备好了热饭和暖和的床铺。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“酒菜”无依据地加入酒，而普通“床铺”又漏掉 warm；改为“热饭和暖和的床铺”可最小而完整地对应原文两个具体事物。

en: It's rather important. I wouldn't trust anyone but you to deliver the message to Lord Shaw.
old: 这真的很重要。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 除了你之外，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不会信任任何人来把这个纸条带给绍尔爵士。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这真的很重要。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 除了你之外，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不会信任任何人来把这个纸条带给绍尔勋爵。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Lord Shaw 确指特定人物，译为“绍尔勋爵”正确；其余内容与原文相符，改动仅修正称号硬错。

en: Aha! That's a knee slapper, Rodney!  Okay. I got one fer ya.
old: 啊！<XXXX/> 那令人捧腹的家伙，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 罗德利！<XXXXXXXX/> 好的。<XXXXXX/> 我也给你来一个。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 啊！<XXXX/> 真让人笑掉大牙，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 罗德利！<XXXXXXXX/> 好的。<XXXXXX/> 我也给你来一个。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “knee slapper”指笑话令人捧腹，原译误将其说成“令人捧腹的家伙”。

en: The society of Dunwall know better than to make an enemy of Waverly Boyle.
old: 顿沃的社会很明事理以至于不会和韦弗利·波义耳成为敌人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 顿沃的社交圈都很清楚，不该与韦弗利·波义耳为敌。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: know better than to 表示明白不该这样做；当前“绝不能”把审慎判断强化成绝对禁令。保留“社交圈”的必要修补，仅降低语气强度。

en: If I have to, I'll let it out that Havelock's father worked in my mines. He'll be laughed out of court!
old: 如果我不得不说的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 哈弗洛克的父亲正在我的矿井里工作。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他会在法院外笑出声来的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 必要的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我就把哈弗洛克的父亲曾在我的矿井里干活的事说出去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 到时他会被整个宫廷嘲笑得待不下去！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把过去时 worked 错成正在工作，并将“laughed out of court”错误直译为在法院外笑出声。

en: Look at him! Yet he believes this malady will pass and he will soon be well.
old: 看看他！<XXXXXXXX/> 他还相信他有痊愈的机会，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 很快就能恢复。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 看看他！<XXXXXXXX/> 他还相信这场病会过去，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 自己很快就能康复。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “will pass”是他确信疾病会过去，不只是认为自己“有痊愈的机会”；旧译无依据减弱了判断强度。

en: It's just a boat trip, upriver. Past the blockades.
old: 只不过是一次航行，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 通向上游。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 突破封锁。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 只不过是坐趟船，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 逆流而上。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 越过封锁线。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: upriver 是逆流而上，past the blockades 只表示越过封锁线；原译“通向上游”和“突破封锁”分别存在方向表达不准及无依据强化武力意味的问题。

en: He drowned thinking of his love.
old: 他在对爱的思考中迷失了自己。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他想着心爱的人，溺死了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把 drowned 错成“迷失了自己”，遗漏溺死事件；当前译文准确恢复了动作及其伴随情境，并保留规定标签。

en: Well, that's that.
old: 很好，就是这样。
new: 好了，就这样吧。
reason: 人工裁决: that's that 表示事情到此为止或已经解决；旧译“很好，就是这样”误作肯定操作方式。

en: Sammy says a lot.  All I know's what Chauncy did.
old: 萨米说得很多。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我只知道昌西死了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 萨米说得很多。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我只知道昌西做了什么。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “what Chauncy did”意为昌西做过什么，原译误成昌西死了。

en: Image strikes the eye. Eye touches the mind. Mind touches the Void. I feel your love for Corvo Attano and your lost mother. For your caretaker Callista. I feel your fear in the night. Your hunger to learn, to become someone important. My hunger, too. My fear. You are becoming mine.
old: 图像映入眼帘。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 目光打开心窗。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 心灵通往虚空。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我能感受到你对科尔沃·阿塔诺以及你那已故母亲的爱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对于你的监护人卡莉斯塔的爱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我能感受到你在夜晚的恐惧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你渴望知识，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也渴望成为大人物。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也同样饥渴，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也同样恐惧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你将成为我的化身。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 图像映入眼帘。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 目光打开心窗。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 心灵通往虚空。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我能感受到你对科尔沃·阿塔诺以及你那已故母亲的爱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对于你的监护人卡莉斯塔的爱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我能感受到你在夜晚的恐惧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你渴望知识，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也渴望成为大人物。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也同样饥渴，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也同样恐惧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你正逐渐属于我。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “You are becoming mine”表示艾米莉逐渐被其占有或控制，旧译“成为我的化身”添加了原文没有的化身含义。

en: And now? She's limping to the outskirts of the city.  She'll pay a smuggler to get past quarantine. She'll watch herself for signs of plague for a while. Gradually, the fear and grief that seep into your bones in Dunwall will dissipate, and she'll find a new name and a new use for her skills.
old: 那么现在呢？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她千辛万苦地来到了城郊地区，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 付钱给走私者以期通过隔离检疫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她要在一段时间里注意自己有没有感染瘟疫的迹象。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那些过去在顿沃城中，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 渗入骨髓的恐惧和忧伤会渐渐消散，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她也会重获新生。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 那么现在呢？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她一瘸一拐地走向城郊地区，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 付钱给走私者以通过隔离检疫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她要在一段时间里注意自己有没有感染瘟疫的迹象。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那些在顿沃城中<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 渗入骨髓的恐惧和忧伤会渐渐消散，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她会换一个新名字，重新施展自己的本领。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将 limping 泛化为“千辛万苦”，并将“换个名字、为自己的本领找到新用途”整段漏译为“重获新生”，需补齐具体语义。

en: May all the spirits guide you, and may our enemy's head hit the floor without you taking a scratch.
old: 愿所有神明引导你，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也愿你能轻松破敌。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 愿所有神灵引导你，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 也愿敌人身首落地，而你毫发无伤。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“轻松破敌”遗漏了敌人头颅落地以及对方毫发无伤两层明确语义。

en: Don't be fooled if you hear laughter, or happen upon a smile. There is no lightness or merriment here.
old: 如果听到欢笑声，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 或是碰巧洋在面上的笑容别被愚弄了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这儿没有光明与欢乐。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 如果听到欢笑声，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 或是碰巧看到一张笑脸，别被愚弄了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这里没有轻松与欢乐。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译有“洋在面上”的明显错字病句，并将 lightness 错译为“光明”。

en: Another slice out of time, Corvo!
old: 又砍慢了，科尔沃！
new: 又从时间中切下一瞬，科尔沃！
reason: 人工裁决: 结合两名能够操纵时间者的决斗语境，slice out of time 指从正常时间中截出的一瞬；现译准确修复了“砍慢了”的误解，并保留科尔沃译名。

en: Nuthin'. He was just a cracked old man.
old: 没什么。<XXXXXXXX/> 他也只是个崩坏了的老人而已。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 没什么。<XXXXXXXX/> 他不过是个疯疯癫癫的老头。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “cracked”指精神失常、疯癫；“崩坏了的老人”有明显生硬直译痕迹。

en: He pleaded with her to leave. Begged her not to help him. But now she is sick too.
old: 他恳求她离开。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 希望她跟他保持距离。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但现在她也被感染了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他恳求她离开。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 求她不要帮助自己。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但现在她也被感染了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Begged her not to help him”明确指求她不要帮助自己，原译“跟他保持距离”遗漏了“帮助”的语义。

en: You're making a huge mistake! I'm a barrister.
old: 你犯下了不可饶恕的错误！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我是大律师。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你犯了一个大错！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我是大律师。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “huge mistake”是“大错”，原译“不可饶恕的错误”无依据地改变了错误性质。

en: We should check the office area--that's where he keeps all his business records.
old: 我们应该检查下办公区--那是他储存办公记录的地方。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我们应该检查一下办公区——他的所有生意记录都放在那里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: business records 是生意或业务记录，并非“办公记录”；同时修复不合中文规范的双连字符。

en: Them? No. But the men who give the orders are a different breed.
old: 他们？<XXXXXX/> 是的他们不怕。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但那个发号施令的人可不一样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他们？<XXXXXX/> 不。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但那些发号施令的人可不一样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Them? No.”是明确否定，原译“是的他们不怕”改变了应答形式；此外 men 为复数，应译为“那些发号施令的人”。

en: When his cousin refused his advances, he sent a Watch patrol to beat her to death.
old: 当她的表姐拒绝了他的求爱后，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他派了一只巡逻队把她打死了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 当他的表姐拒绝了他的求爱后，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他派了一支巡逻队把她打死了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: his cousin 被错译为“她的表姐”，且量词“一只巡逻队”错误。

en: Not till the next batch of Elixir's done. He'll want to check on things.
old: 下一批药剂制成前他就会来了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他想来检查一下东西。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 下一批药剂制成前他不会来。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他会想检查一下情况。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Not till”表示在下一批药剂制成前不会来，原译成制成前就会来，时间关系颠倒。

en: But in the end, you chose the more measured response. What will that mean in the days to come, I wonder.
old: 但在最后，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你选择了更为慎重的回答。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在接下来的日子里到底会发生什么呢，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我很好奇。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 但最终，<XXXXXXXXXX/>你选择了更为慎重的应对方式。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>这对未来的日子意味着什么，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>我很好奇。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: response 在此指采取的应对方式而非口头“回答”；what will that mean 也不是泛指“会发生什么”。

en: It was good of them to give us a jar of soup broth.
old: 他们给我们一碗肉汤就很不错了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他们给我们一罐肉汤就很不错了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “a jar of soup broth”是一罐肉汤，并非一碗。

en: The key is right beside him.
old: 钥匙就在他傍边。
new: 钥匙就在他旁边。
reason: 人工裁决: “傍边”是错别字，应为“旁边”。

en: No, no, no, no, no...  * sobs *
old: 不，<XXXX/> 不，<XXXX/> 不，<XXXX/> 不......*抽泣*
new: 不，<XXXX/> 不，<XXXX/> 不，<XXXX/> 不，不......*抽泣*
reason: 人工裁决: 英文连续说了五次“No”，原译仅保留四次，存在漏译。

en: Well done, Corvo. Well done. I doubt a dozen soldiers could have done it better.
old: 干得好，<XXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 干得好。<XXXXXXXX/> 我相信一队士兵也不能做的更好。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 干得好，<XXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 干得好。<XXXXXXXX/> 我相信一队士兵也不能做得更好。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “做的更好”存在明显的“的/得”误用，其余译意成立。

en: Just get moving. This is it!
old: 快走。就是这样了！
new: 快走。时候到了！
reason: 人工裁决: 结合前句询问众人去向及后句担心被杀，This is it 表示危急时刻已经到来；“就是这样了”未准确传达这一话语功能。

en: Are you crazy? They can hear anything you say.
old: 你疯了吗？<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你说什么他们都听的到。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你疯了吗？<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你说什么他们都听得到。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “听的到”是明显错字，应为“听得到”。

en: Probably rats. Into everything.
old: 很可能是老鼠，那儿都钻了。
new: 很可能是老鼠，哪儿都钻。
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“那儿都钻”是明显错字，应为表示 everywhere 的“哪儿都钻”。

en: When I find you, I'm going to mince you to little bits.
old: 等我找到你的时候 我要把你剁成小块。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 等我找到你的时候，我要把你剁成小块。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译两个分句之间缺少标点；补入逗号，其余语义及标签保持不变。

en: Big changes. Makes me uneasy, to tell the truth. The small fry like me always gets the worst of it.
old: 真是一场巨变。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 说实话，<XXXXXXXX/> 挺过来真是不容易。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好像我经常经历那些最坏的事情。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 真是一场巨变。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 说实话，<XXXXXXXX/> 这让我心里不安。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 像我这样的小人物总是遭殃最重。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

old: 嘿，<XXXX/> 不见了，<XXXXXXXX/> 我非剁了那小子的手指头不可。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 嘿，<XXXX/> 不见了，<XXXXXXXX/> 我非掰断那小子的手指头不可。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: break somebody's fingers 指掰断手指，原译“剁了”变成砍断，伤害方式明显错译；仅修正该动词并保留标签。

en: Oh!  There went my invitation!
old: 啊！我的邀请函！
new: 啊！我的邀请函飞走了！
reason: 人工裁决: There went 表示邀请函刚刚飞走或掉走，原译遗漏了这一关键动作。

en: A reminder to all citizens: Inspect your neighbor's faces closely. If there is any sign of blood on the eyelids or cheeks, you must notify one of the City Watch. Early stages of the plague involve coughing and fever, and can often be remedied through the liberal consumption of Sokolov's Elixir. Once bleeding from the eyes occurs, death is inevitable. All suspicions of plague, regardless of severity, much be reported.
old: 致各位市民的敬告：请仔细检查你邻居的脸颊。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果有人的眼皮或者颧骨上有血印，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 务必向城市警卫报告。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 瘟疫的早期症状有发烧与咳嗽，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 能被索科洛夫万能药轻易治愈。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果有血液从眼中流出，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那么死亡就不可避免。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有任何可疑的病例，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 无论严重与否，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 必须上报。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 致各位市民的敬告：请仔细检查你邻居的脸。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果有人的眼皮或者脸颊上有血迹，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 务必向城市警卫报告。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 瘟疫的早期症状有咳嗽和发烧，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 通常可通过大量服用索科洛夫生命药剂来缓解。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果有血液从眼中流出，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那么死亡就不可避免。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有任何疑似瘟疫的情况，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 无论严重与否，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 都必须上报。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文正确区分 faces、cheeks，并采用固定药剂名；liberal consumption 的大量服用和 remedied 的缓解含义均得到保留，避免了原译“轻易治愈”的过强断言。

en: On the way you can explain what you're getting me into upriver.
old: 路上和我说下你把我卷进了河上游什么事吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 路上你可以跟我说说，上游到底有什么事要把我卷进去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“卷进了河上游什么事”句式生硬且关系不清；英文意为在路上解释上游有什么事要让说话人介入。

en: If he did it was a terrible plan. He's trapped himself up there.
old: 如果他这么干了的话那这真是个糟糕的计划，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他把自己陷在这儿了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 如果他这么干了的话那这真是个糟糕的计划，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他把自己困在那上面了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文“up there”明确指较高处，原译“这儿”造成地点指代错误；“trapped himself”也应为把自己困住。

en: Handle them gently, or they will explode and kill us both. Did I mention that already?
old: 轻拿轻放，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 否则它们会爆炸并且杀死我们所有人的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不是说过了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 轻拿轻放，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 否则它们会爆炸，把我们两个都炸死。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我已经说过这事了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: us both 明确指“我们两个”，原译“我们所有人”指代错误；末句也应是询问是否已经提过。

en: Quite a bloodbath at the Golden Cat. Well, at least it will strike some fear into those who oppose us.
old: 金猫这地方简直是一个血池。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好吧，<XXXXXX/> 至少这会使反对我们的人感到一些畏惧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 金猫那里简直血流成河。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好吧，<XXXXXX/> 至少这会使反对我们的人感到一些畏惧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: bloodbath 指血腥屠杀或血流成河，原译“一个血池”是明显的生硬直译。

en: Had a fun night out, did you?
old: 一个愉快的夜晚，不是吗？
new: 出去玩了一晚，很开心吧？
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文补出了原文明确的外出经历和对对方是否尽兴的询问，修补必要且未增加额外信息。

en: Magnificent beasts. They know only cruelty and hunger.
old: 了不起的野兽。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们不知仁慈为何物，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 眼中只有猎物。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 了不起的野兽。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 它们只知残忍，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 与饥饿。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 英文明确为“cruelty and hunger”；原译将“饥饿”改成“猎物”，并误用人物代词“他们”。

en: Do you know, Emily is quite special. She's learned from all of us. You especially. She trusts you absolutely, I believe.
old: 你知道的，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 艾米莉确实很特殊。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她从我们所有人身上不断的学习着。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 尤其是你。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 她绝对的信任着你，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我相信这一点。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你知道吗，<XXXXXXXXXX/>艾米莉确实很特别。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>她从我们所有人身上都学到了东西。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>尤其是你。<XXXXXXXXXX/>她完全信任你，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>我相信这一点。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把问语 Do you know 译成陈述性的“你知道的”，且多处“不断的学习着、绝对的信任着”存在明显语法和直译问题。

en: You wanna make some bootleg elixir for yourself, you go ahead. Can't have you catchin' the plague.
old: 要是想给自己找点私酿灵药的话就随便拿吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 能让你避免染上瘟疫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 要是想给自己做点私酿灵药的话就动手吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 可不能让你染上瘟疫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “go ahead”是允许对方自行制作，原译“随便拿”误成拿取现成药剂；后句也应表达不能让对方染病。

en: Pffft!
old: 该死！
new: 呸！
reason: 人工裁决: 修正天邈原译。“Pffft”是轻蔑或嫌恶的嗤声，并非具有明确咒骂语义的“该死”；同批男性共享对白也译作“呸”。

en: No, foul things. Help me!
old: 滚开蠢东西，快来帮我！
new: 不，肮脏的东西！救救我！
reason: 人工裁决: 原译遗漏了 No，并将 foul 错译为“蠢”；当前译文恢复否定、辱骂和求救三层含义，改动虽明显但均由原文支持。

en: I heard a stilt walker pass a few blocks away. They must suspect we're here.
old: 我听说一个高跷士兵经过了这里的几个街区。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们一定怀疑我们在这里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我听到一个高跷士兵从几条街外经过。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们一定怀疑我们在这里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: heard 在此是听到其经过，a few blocks away 指几条街之外；原译“听说”及“经过这里的几个街区”均有偏差。

en: You'd have to be Corvo, in other words.
old: 换句话说，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你就是科尔沃本人了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 换句话说，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你得是科尔沃才行。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “you'd have to be”表达必要条件，原译“你就是科尔沃本人”误成了对身份的断言。

en: All these rats, crawling all over everything.
old: 满城的老鼠，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 四处地爬呀爬呀。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这些老鼠，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 到处乱爬。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: all these rats 仅指眼前这些老鼠，原译“满城”擅自扩大为全城；同时保留原有片段标签。

en: I could do it, though. I could kill him. If I wanted to. You know that, don't you?
old: 尽管我可以直接干掉他。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果我想的话。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你懂我的意思的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 是吧？<XXXXXX/>
new: 不过，我能做到。我可以杀了他。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果我想的话。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你知道的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对吧？<XXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译用“尽管”形成无后续主句的病句，并将 you know that 偏译为“你懂我的意思”；修补后恢复原文的重复强调和指代。

en: The Lord Regent gave us command of the streets. We didn't ask for it.
old: 摄政王命令我们驻守街道。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不是我们请愿的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 摄政王把街道的管辖权交给了我们。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这可不是我们要求的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: gave us command of the streets 指授予街道管辖权，原译“命令我们驻守街道”将权力授予误作具体命令。

en: I know it's you, Daud. No one else was even close to finding me.
old: 我知道是你，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 道德。<XXXXXX/> 任何其他人甚至都不可能找到我的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我知道是你，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 道德。<XXXXXX/> 其他人离找到我都还差得远。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把“远未接近找到我”强化成“不可能找到我”，改变了程度和事实判断；改为保留原文比较程度的最小修补。

en: Oh, more of my little birdies!
old: 噢，更多的小小鸟！
new: 噢，又来了一些我的小小鸟！
reason: 人工裁决: 原译漏掉所有格“my”，且“more of”在此表示又来了一些。

en: So this is art? Awful lousy way to make coin. Poor bastard. Stuff can't be worth nothin', can they?
old: 所以这就是艺术？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 用这么下贱的办法去赚钱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 可怜虫啊。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 是个东西都能值点钱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不是吗？<XXXXXXXX/>
new: 所以这就是艺术？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 靠这玩意儿赚钱可真够惨的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 可怜虫啊。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 这些东西根本不值钱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对吧？<XXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“是个东西都能值点钱”与“Stuff can't be worth nothin'”含义相反；同时修正“Awful lousy way”的生硬偏译，并保留全部片段标签。

en: Orders remain the same, but I suspect it won't matter. I know where he's going. He will come to me. He'll have to.
old: 命令不变，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 但我想这无所谓了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我知道他去哪儿了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他迟早会来。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他必须得来。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 命令不变，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 但我想这无所谓了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我知道他要去哪儿。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他迟早会来。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他必须得来。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: where he's going 表示他将前往的目的地，原译“去哪儿了”误成已经发生的去向。

en: She'll need higher mathematics. Court protocol. And cosmology, of course. Can you provide these thing?
old: 她需要更多的数学、法学与天文学知识。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你能提供这些教育吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 她需要学习高等数学、宫廷礼仪，当然还有宇宙学。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>你能提供这些教育吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将 higher mathematics、court protocol、cosmology 分别译成“更多的数学、法学、天文学”，均有明显语义偏差。

en: Corvo, my boy! Alive?!
old: 科尔沃，<XXXXXXXX/> 我的天哪！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 还活着？<XXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/>
new: 科尔沃，<XXXXXXXX/> 好小子！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 还活着？<XXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/>
reason: 人工裁决: my boy 是对科尔沃的亲昵称呼，原译“我的天哪”错译为单纯惊叹。

en: It's over, Hiram. Your head will roll for what you've done.
old: 都结束了，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 海罗姆。<XXXXXXXX/> 你会为你的所作所为付出代价。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 都结束了，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 海罗姆。<XXXXXXXX/> 你会为你的所作所为掉脑袋。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: your head will roll 明确威胁将其处死，原译泛化为“付出代价”，遗漏了死亡含义。

en: And remember, guardsman, we must make sure they keep turning. It would look very bad on your record, very bad indeed, should the factory shut down on your watch.
old: 还有牢记，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 警卫们，<XXXXXXXX/> 我们必须确保它们保持旋转。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果工厂在你的看管下停工，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那你的个人记录会非常难看，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 真的非常难看。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 还有牢记，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 警卫，<XXXXXXXX/> 我们必须确保它们保持旋转。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果工厂在你的看管下停工，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那你的个人记录会非常难看，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 真的非常难看。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 英文“guardsman”是对一名警卫的单数称呼，原译“警卫们”误成复数。

en: Fine then. I suppose you'd rather not stick your neck out for me.
old: 那好吧。<XXXXXXXX/> 我想你也不会为我的事操心。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 那好吧。<XXXXXXXX/> 我想你是不愿意为我冒险。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “stick your neck out”意为冒险相助，不是仅仅为某事操心。

en: Whale bones are powerful magic. But wait til I carve on your bones, SlackJaw. The bones of my enemy! Then everyone will do what Granny say!
old: 鲸骨是非常强大的魔法。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但等我刻在你的骨头上，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 大嘴巴。<XXXXXXXX/> 我敌人的骨头！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 之后所有人就都会听命于我！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 鲸骨蕴含着强大的魔力。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但等我在你的骨头上刻完再瞧吧，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 大嘴巴。<XXXXXXXX/> 我敌人的骨头！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 之后所有人就都会听奶奶的话！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文修正了将鲸骨直接等同于魔法的错误，补全了雕刻动作，并准确保留 Granny 的第三人称自称“奶奶”。

en: Always keep it on when you're away from this place. The dogs of the City Watch will attack you on sight, but this mask will keep them from recognizing who you really are. Since the plague, masks are common in the streets, though yours is stranger than most.
old: 当你离开这里时一定把它戴上。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 城市警卫的猎犬看到你就会攻击，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但是这个面具可是避免它们认出你是谁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 自从瘟疫开始，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在街上戴面具已经很平常了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 只不过你的看起来比大多数人的要奇怪些罢了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 当你离开这里时一定把它戴上。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 城市警卫的走狗一看到你就会攻击，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但是这个面具会让他们认不出你的真实身份。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 自从瘟疫开始，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在街上戴面具已经很平常了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 只不过你的看起来比大多数人的要奇怪些罢了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: dogs of the City Watch 是对城市警卫成员的贬称，原译成真正的“猎犬”造成实体误判；同时修正面具句的病句。

en: Only a matter of time before this is all over. If it goes our way, it'll be glorious.
old: 结束这一切只是时间问题。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果按照我们的计划，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这将会是十分的荣耀的事。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 结束这一切只是时间问题。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果事情如我们所愿，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那将会无比辉煌。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “goes our way”意为事情如己方所愿，不只是按计划进行；“glorious”应表达辉煌，旧译末句存在明显病句。

en: Welcome back, Master Corvo!
old: 欢迎回来，科尔沃大师！
new: 欢迎回来，科尔沃大人！
reason: 人工裁决: Master 在此是仆从对主人的敬称，应译为“大人”；“大师”误成技能或资历称号。

en: You're askin' for trouble. Keep it up.
old: 你在自找麻烦，小心点。
new: 你在自找麻烦。继续啊。
reason: 人工裁决: Keep it up 是带威胁或讥讽意味的“继续啊”，原译“小心点”改变了话语含义。

en: The armed forces will do their job. Martin has control of the Overseers. And you, Treavor, do whatever it is you do with Parliament.
old: 武装力量会做好他们的工作。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 马丁已经接管了督军。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而你，<XXXXXX/> 特雷弗，<XXXXXXXX/> 随便对议会做点什么。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 武装力量会做好他们的工作。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 马丁已经控制了督军。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而你，<XXXXXX/> 特雷弗，<XXXXXXXX/> 就继续去议会里做你那些事吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “whatever it is you do with Parliament”是带讽刺意味地让特雷弗处理其议会事务，并非随便对议会做点什么。

en: Oh? What's this?
old: 噢？什么？
new: 噢？这是什么？
reason: 人工裁决: 原译漏掉“this”的指示含义，导致“什么？”表达不完整。

en: Maybe we'd have more privacy in your chambers?
old: 也许我们该去你的房间，那里有足够的“私人空间”
new: 也许我们该去你的房间，那里有足够的“私人空间”？
reason: 人工裁决: 原文为疑问句，原译缺少句末问号；其余措辞可保留。

en: If she's still alive she'd be able to get you everything you need to know about that ship, no question. And a substantial reward besides.
old: 要是她还活着的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她会告诉你一切关于那艘船的事，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 绝对的。<XXXXXXXX/> 此外还有可能给你一份奖励。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 要是她还活着的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她会告诉你一切关于那艘船的事，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 绝对的。<XXXXXXXX/> 此外她还会给你一笔丰厚的报酬。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “a substantial reward”是确定且丰厚的报酬，原译“可能给一份奖励”错误削弱了确定性和数额。

en: I could use a drink.
old: 我可以带瓶酒。
new: 我想喝一杯。

en: Remember those gas traps Trimble kept going on about?

en: Yes, let's look at what you've got.

en: Sokolov here. Excellent progress today. Test subject 312 is declining rapidly. As I theorized, Formulas 12 and 17 administered in combination greatly accelerated the progression of the disease.  Interestingly, the respiratory mucosa have erupted and raised pustules, greyish in color, which burst, causing hemorrhaging and pain. I now turn my hopes and energies to Formula 25, which, in conjunction with a high heat therapy which came to me most vividly in a dream last night, has great potential, according to the latest celestial alignment. As for test subject 312, after the characteristic sloughing of the skin, she should be dead by mid-morning tomorrow.
old: 这里是索科洛夫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 今天进展得很顺利。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 试验对象312正在迅速衰退。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 正如我所推论的那样，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 将12号和17号配方混合在一起调制出的药剂极大地加速了疾病的发生。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有趣的是，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 试验对象的呼吸道黏膜出疹并长出了灰色的脓疱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 一旦破裂，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 就会引起出血和疼痛。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在我将我的希望和精力转向了25号配方，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 与高温治疗相结合，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 在昨晚清晰地出现在我的梦境中，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 根据最近的天相来看，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 它拥有巨大潜能。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 至于试验体312，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 当皮肤彻底腐败后，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她应该会在明天上午死亡。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这里是索科洛夫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 今天进展得很顺利。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 试验对象312的状况正在迅速恶化。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 正如我所推论的那样，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 12号和17号配方联合使用，极大地加快了疾病进程。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有趣的是，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 试验对象的呼吸道黏膜出现病变，并隆起了灰色脓疱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 一旦破裂，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 就会引起出血和疼痛。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在我将希望和精力转向25号配方，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 将它与一种高温疗法结合，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那疗法昨晚清晰地出现在我的梦中，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 根据最近的天相来看，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 它拥有巨大潜能。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 至于试验对象312，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 当皮肤出现特有的脱落后，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她应该会在明天上午死亡。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将联合施用两种配方写成混合调制药剂，将疾病 progression 弱化为“发生”，并把皮肤 sloughing 错译为“彻底腐败”。

en: The need for drink outweighs all else for this one.

en: Lord Pendleton Memoirs, chapter 41.  In which I bed two of the Boyle women, and only missed the third by virtue of some inclement weather.  It was the Month of Rain, and to counter the gloom, the Boyle ladies hosted three nights of merriment by invitation only. Lydia was most fetching in lavender pants and a tunic of yellow silk. She was pleased with me from the moment I walked in the door -  with my man servant bringing not one but two cases of effervescent wine from the south. In fact I had come laden with gifts, such that all three Boyle women soon took notice, and they set out to make me more than welcome. en: What we have is a man, aged thirty perhaps, slender. Unusual tattooing on the face and chest. Probably superstitious heresy. Wearing some sort of industrial mask when we brought him in, stolen out of one of the whaling factories from the look of it. (Pause) (To the subject) You're one of Daud's men, aren't you? Caught at last. (Brief pause) Give us a name, at least. (To others) What's wrong with his eyes? Opium? Laudanum? (To the subject) Are you with us? (To others) What's he doing? (Louder) Some kind of fit!? (Sounds of convulsions) (Pause) He's gone. (Pause) Here it is; a pin, hidden in one of his gloves. (More official) Subject has administered some kind of poison. The effects seem to have been lethal.

en: The Academy teaches that absurd idea that the energy in whale oil arises from the need to maintain life functions at the extreme Ocean depths. I could build a tank that would slowly increase pressure on a subject over a long period of time, and then observe them, for years if need be, to see if the formulation of the energetic substance develops. en: Barrister Timsh! All right? He told me the story. Delilah was a woman he knew. Grew up working in Dunwall Tower. Got kicked out and became a painter. Had funny airs, like proud. en: We're getting closer to reaching our goals, but our position is becoming more dangerous. You don't house and feed half a dozen people without leaving telltale traces. Riverboats pass day and night and the looters are going to start gathering once they're sure the plague has burned the place out. I conclude: if our enemies are not dead by the Month of Wind, we will be. There's a sadness in Emily, but she's strong, weathering the death of her mother just half a year ago better than most grown men I've known. Once we take Dunwall Tower, I'll see that her life is better. I've always thought that I'd command the navy in her name, but sometimes I wonder if I shouldn't just take the title Lord Regent, and do it properly.

en: Chapter 32. As yet I have said little of my brothers, Morgan and Custis. Twins they are, and four years senior to me. Morgan is the larger of the two brutes, by a slight bit.  From earliest memory they abused me in every way. I'm not the first to claim their elder siblings were cruel, but my suffering was unique, I promise you. At the tender age of five, they tied me to the crib, and set inside it assorted vipers they had collected over several weeks. My howls - and my breathing - were muffled by a blanket, and so it was hours before the nurse found me, barely alive. I had kicked a few serpents to a pulp, and others had slithered away, but not before I'd been bitten a dozen times or more - on my legs, arms, and face.  The wounds kept me convalescing for months, while those two got away with barely a tongue lashing! (Turns away from recording, breathless) Wallace! Bring me wine! (back to recorder, darkly) Tomorrow I will regale you with the special gift they gave me on my tenth birthday party.

en: Restrict an errant mind before it becomes fractious and divided. Can two enemies occupy the same body? No, for the first will direct it one way, and the second another, until they stumble into a ditch. Likewise, two contrary thoughts cannot long abide in a man's mind, or he will become weak-willed and subject to any heresy. Restrict the lying tongue that is like a spark in a man's mouth. It is such a little thing, yet from one spark an entire city may burn to the ground. The father of a lie will suffer a punishment compounded by each person relayed it. Restrict roving feet that love to trespass. They pay no heed to the boundary stones of other men's fields. They wander into foreign lands, only to return with their soles blackened by iniquity.

The Delilah's coming back fully loaded. No reports of lights or singing; another sign the Barrister's lost it. The Huntress is in dry-dock after a night-time ramming off Pandyssia; engineers looked at the damage, they say wasn't a whale. Or if it was, it was a very odd-looking one.

en: Seen anybody with signs of the sickness?

en: If Slackjaw could see me now.

en: Mind yourself. Step back.

new: 小心点。退后。

en: I think the Admiral's awfully distinguished, don't you?

en: You gotta talk to Blake. He's my brother. He knows everything.

en: Someone should show them.

en: Keep it moving, we can't get caught doing this.

en: My gentlemen callers don't come around like they used to.  You took care of it for me, didn't you? That's nice.

new: 来找我的绅士们不像以前那样常来了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你帮我解决了这件事，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对吗？<XXXXXX/> 真棒。<XXXXXX/>

en: Never mind that. Lord Pendleton ought to be shown the respect he deserves. He doesn't require it, but he notices.

en: Had to leave the Flooded District, we did. For sure. Then the warehouse. How long will we stay at the manor? How long...

en: The Watch doesn't care about a few kids. Maybe the Overseers should go down there.

en: What in the--!

en: Anton Sokolov. He knew me once. And did much to set me on my path.

en: She bought the finest elixirs. Perhaps she did not take them in time.

reason: 人工裁决: Perhaps 表示推测；原译“但她没按时吃”错误地将其说成确定事实。

en: Look here, it's twenty. That's five each. Counting Boo.

new: 看这里，<XXXXXXXX/> 是二十块。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 每个人五块。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 把布也算上。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Go down, you pig!

en: I hope you have been courteous to his Lordship. When he comes into his power, he will be a man to fear.
old: 我想你已经领略过阁下他谦和有礼的一面了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 当他掌权后，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他会成为一位令人敬畏的人物。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

new: 我父亲曾在阿尔弗雷德潘德顿将军麾下上过战场，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 并在那里负伤致残。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 若有召唤，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我希望自己也不会逊色。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不过在那之前，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好吧，<XXXXXX/> 还有不少银器要擦呢。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译第二句结构残缺，并把“负伤致残”错误组织成一场使他变瘸的战役。

en: When I catch you I'll show you what we used to do to the nobles we caught, traveling out on the road.

new: 等我逮到你，我会让你见识一下我们以前是怎么对付那些贵族的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 就是那些在路上被我们抓到的家伙。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“让他们游街”误解了 traveling out on the road；原文指贵族在路上旅行时被抓获。

en: Do you think it's better out there?  I hate to break it to you, but this is IT.
old: 你认为在出去会更好吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不愿意打破你的幻想，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但事实就是那样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你认为出去以后会更好吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不愿打破你的幻想，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但现实就是这样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 旧译“你认为在出去会更好吗”存在明显语病；this is IT 指眼前现实就是如此。

en: How many beatings have I taken this year? Aint right.
old: 今年我都被打多少次了？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不是嘛。<XXXXXXXX/>
new: 今年我都被打多少次了？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这不对。<XXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Ain't right”表示此事不对或不公，原译“不是嘛”变成附和式反问。

en: Maybe you should ask that stuck-up servant what happened to his master.

new: 也许你该问问那个趾高气扬的侍者，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 问他的主子出了什么事。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
