en: Thorpe slipped him the key, everyone knows that. He got weak, they paid him off, but he couldn't tell us who it was. And believe me, he wanted to by the end.
old: 索普把钥匙偷偷给他了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 所有人都知道。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他身体很虚弱，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有人收买他，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但他不告诉我们究竟是谁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 相信我，<XXXXXXXX/> 他想保留秘密直到死去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 索普把钥匙偷偷给他了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 所有人都知道。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他一时心软，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们收买了他，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但他没能告诉我们那人是谁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 相信我，<XXXXXXXX/> 到最后他可是很想说出来。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将“got weak”错作身体虚弱，并把“到最后很想供出来”译成“保守秘密直到死去”，含义完全相反。

en: Was that a rumble? Is this stuff flowing in here?
old: 是不是有轰隆的声音？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这儿的这东西是不是在流？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 刚才是轰隆声吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这东西是不是流进来了？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: flowing in here 强调流入此处，旧译只说“在流”，且整句有明显生硬直译腔。

en: Quite.  I keep the document with me at all times.  You never know when you'll need it.
old: 安静。<XXXXXX/> 我随时都带着这份文件，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你永远不知道它什么时候能派上用场。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 正是。<XXXXXX/>我随时都带着这份文件，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>你永远不知道它什么时候能派上用场。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Quite 在此是表示赞同的“正是、确实”，原译“安静”属于明确错译。

en: General? General Tobias!? What's happening down there?!
old: 将军？<XXXXXX/> 托比亚斯将军！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ？<XX/> 到底发生了什么？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> ！<XX/>
new: 将军？<XXXXXX/>托比亚斯将军？！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/><XX/>下面到底发生什么了？！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/><XX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 修正标签周围被拆散、重复的问号和叹号，并补出 down there 的“下面”。

en: These waters are greedy. They will never give back what they have taken.
old: 这些河水是贪婪的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 它们永远不会还回他们曾带走的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这些河水是贪婪的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 它们永远不会归还自己夺走的东西。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 旧译把指代河水的 they 错写成“他们”，且后半句表达生硬。

en: The one who walks here is all things. Cradle songs of comfort and bones gnawed by teeth.
old: 一切都经过这里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 无论是安逸的摇篮曲还是被牙齿啃咬过的骨头。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 行走于此者即是万物。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 抚慰人心的摇篮曲，以及被牙齿啃咬的骨头。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 该句属于虚空评论，当前候选正确恢复了“The one who walks here”作为主语，并保留“即是万物”的诗性表达；原译主客关系颠倒，因此采用当前修补版。

en: Stay away.
old: 离开。
new: 离远点。
reason: 人工裁决: Stay away 是警告对方保持距离；“离开”可能被理解为单纯要求离去。

en: This is your final chance, Corvo. Sign the confession and let me give you the rites to put your spirit at ease.
old: 这是你最后的机会，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 只要你招供，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我马上就能判你死刑，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 结束你的痛苦。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这是你最后的机会，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 签下供词，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 让我为你举行仪式，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好让你的灵魂得到安宁。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将“举行仪式使灵魂安宁”错译为“判处死刑、结束痛苦”，且漏掉签署供词之意。

en: In three months, I wonder if this will all be over. Be nice if the shops opened again.
old: 在三个月内，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我不知道这会不会全部结束。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果商店重新开张的话就更好了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 三个月后，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不知道这一切会不会结束。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果商店能重新开张就好了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: In three months 指“三个月后”，原译“在三个月内”改变了时间点。

en: No one here can sing. I think we could use some song here. Some music.
old: 这里没人会唱歌。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我想我们应该这儿放点音乐。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 放点音乐。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这里没人会唱歌。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我觉得这里应该有人唱唱歌。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 来点音乐。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将 song 和 music 都译成“音乐”，造成无依据的重复，并有“应该这儿放”的明显病句。

en: If you say so.
old: 如你所说。
new: 你说是就是吧。
reason: 人工裁决: If you say so是表示勉强接受或保留意见的惯用语；“如你所说”是生硬直译且丢失语气。

en: Do you ever hear you name, in the buzzing of the flies?
old: 你有没有苍蝇的嗡嗡作响中听见自己的名字过？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你有没有在苍蝇的嗡嗡声中听见过自己的名字？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译缺少介词“在”，语序明显不通；调整为自然中文并原样保留标签。

en: Ah! They're swarming!
old: 啊！它们成群了！
new: 啊！它们成群涌来了！
reason: 人工裁决: “They're swarming”指它们正成群涌来，原译“它们成群了”句式生硬且动作含义不清。

en: Custis is easier to manage. Some nights he just waits in the Gold room and talks to a girl. It's funny what people will pay for.
old: 寇斯提思就好办多了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有时候他就只呆在黄金室里和一个女孩聊天。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 人们付钱来这儿的理由真是又多又有趣。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 寇斯提思就好办多了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有时候他就只呆在黄金室里和一个女孩聊天。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 人们竟会为这种事花钱，真是有趣。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原末句确实误解了付钱对象，须修正；“黄金室”能够准确对应 Gold room，作用域参考译名“金屋”并非硬约束，因此不接受其连带替换。

en: The way you fight, the things you can do... You could change the Empire, if you set your mind to it. I wonder why you never did.

new: 你战斗的方式，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你能做的那些事......只要你想，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你就能改变这个帝国。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我想知道你为什么从没这么做过。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “why you never did”指为何从未去改变帝国，原译“从没这么想过”将实际行动误成了想法。

en: Get lost. Think that masks makes you safe?

new: 滚开。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你以为那面具能保证你的安全吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: If the plague lifts. And the City Watch doesn't throw us all into the river.
old: 那要等鼠疫消失。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 还有城市警卫没把我们俩都扔进河里才行。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 那要等鼠疫消失。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 还有城市警卫没把我们所有人都扔进河里才行。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: us all 指说话人所属的所有人，原译“我们俩”无依据地缩小为两人。

en: Ahh! You're ruthless! Don't hold back. I'll tell you everything. The Pendleton's inheritance was worth hundreds of thousands at least. Told them it was junk.

old: 老鼠干的。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 他在国会的办公室底下连接着一条老旧的下水道，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有一天它被水淹没了然后老鼠都冲了出来。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 人们说别的大人们在他逃跑的路上设置了障碍使他们自己得救。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 尖叫声持续了数个小时。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他央求呼喊他们的名字，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但他们还是让他自生自灭。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 老鼠干的。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 他在议会的办公室底下有一条老旧的下水道，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 有一天那里被水淹了，老鼠全都冲了出来。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 听说其他大人为了自保，把他堵在了里面。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 尖叫声持续了数个小时。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他苦苦哀求，一一呼喊他们的名字，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但他们还是任他死去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Well, I know a hunnert of those old rhymes. My mummy used to tell 'em at me.

new: 对的，<XXXXXX/> 我知道很多押韵诗。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我妈妈以前经常念给我听。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Shh! I'm trying to listen. This can't happen to me. I pay the City Watch a fortune for protection.

new: 他们自从被带来这里后就再也没有离开过。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 督军总能找到他们想要的罪名。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: There's a special door to come and go, for special people. I'll show you. And if anyone tries to stop us, you can fight them.

en: Hey! They told me to not to let anyone up here. Do me a favor and head back down?

en: This place is on the river. So you must have come by boat.

en: I don't know, but it smells like something died in the circulator.  Let's go out back and wait for it to clear out.

en: Chapter 32. As yet I have said little of my brothers, Morgan and Custis. Twins they are, and four years senior to me. Morgan is the larger of the two brutes, by a slight bit.  From earliest memory they abused me in every way. I'm not the first to claim their elder siblings were cruel, but my suffering was unique, I promise you. At the tender age of five, they tied me to the crib, and set inside it assorted vipers they had collected over several weeks. My howls - and my breathing - were muffled by a blanket, and so it was hours before the nurse found me, barely alive. I had kicked a few serpents to a pulp, and others had slithered away, but not before I'd been bitten a dozen times or more - on my legs, arms, and face.  The wounds kept me convalescing for months, while those two got away with barely a tongue lashing! (Turns away from recording, breathless) Wallace! Bring me wine! (back to recorder, darkly) Tomorrow I will regale you with the special gift they gave me on my tenth birthday party.

en: Some of us will be great. The Boyles, at least.

new: 我们中的一部分将会成为伟人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 至少波义耳一家会。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “The Boyles”泛指波义耳一家，原译擅自限定为“三姐妹”，添加了原文没有的信息。

en: Emily's first act will be to rescind the warrant for your arrest. We can finally take that mask off of you.
old: 艾米莉的首秀将是撤销对你的追捕令。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在我们终于能将你的面具摘下来了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 艾米莉上台后的第一件事将是撤销对你的逮捕令。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在我们终于能将你的面具摘下来了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “first act”指上台后的第一项举措，不是表演意义的“首秀”；warrant for arrest 应为逮捕令。

en: His hands do violence. But there is a different dream in his heart.
old: 他使用暴力，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但心中仍有一个不同的梦想。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他的双手施以暴力，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但心中仍有一个不同的梦想。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文以原译为底稿补回了 hands 的明确意象，同时仍将 heart 按比喻义译为“心中”，没有误套超自然物品名称。

en: Someone very dangerous it seems. Good riddance to you, sir. So many schemes you had and so many contracts. How many people did I kill for you? None like the last. None like her. I'd give back all the coin if I could. No one should have to kill an Empress.
old: 看上去是个很危险的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 对你来说总算是解脱了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 先生。<XXXXXX/> 你有如此多的阴谋，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如此多的契约。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我为你杀过多少人？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 没人像最后这位这样，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 没人和她一样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果可以我宁愿奉还所有报酬。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 任何人都不该杀死一位女皇。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 看上去是个很危险的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你总算完蛋了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 先生。<XXXXXX/> 你有如此多的阴谋，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如此多的契约。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我为你杀过多少人？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 最后那个人与众不同，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 没人像她一样。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果可以我宁愿奉还所有报酬。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 谁都不该被迫去杀一位女皇。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文准确纠正了 Good riddance 和 should have to 的含义；“最后那个人与众不同，没人像她一样”也忠实对应连续两句 None like。

en: He recites the Seven Strictures. But he is thinking about blood ox steak.
old: 他表面上背诵着七约令，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 脑海里却在想着沾血的牛排。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他背诵着七约令，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 脑海里却在想着血牛排。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “blood ox steak”是血牛的牛排，原译“沾血的牛排”误解为带血的牛排；英文也没有“表面上”的信息。

en: He and his thugs started in Treavers Alley. Now his influence is felt over the entire Island of Gristol.
old: 他以及他的恶棍们是从崔维斯小巷起家的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在他的影响已经遍布整个格里斯托岛了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 他以及他的恶棍们是从特里维尔小巷起家的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 现在他的影响已经遍布整个格里斯托岛了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Treavers Alley”中的地名应与术语表所列 Treaver 地名统一为“特里维尔”，当前“崔维斯”不一致；其余内容保留。

en: So many dead. At least they were mostly commoners.
old: 如此多的生命逝去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他们大部分都只是普通人啊。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 如此多的生命逝去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好在他们大多只是平民。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “At least”体现说话人庆幸死者多为平民的冷酷态度，旧译语气变成感叹，丢失关键含义。

en: He'll report anyone for an extra half ration.
old: 任何申请得到更多配给的人都会被他报告上去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 为了多拿半份配给，他谁都肯告发。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译颠倒了行为动机和举报对象；当前译文准确表达他会为多得半份配给而告发任何人，结构调整是纠正硬错所必需。

en: I, Admiral Farley Havelock, humbly accept the mantle of Lord Regent of the State of Gristol and all its Imperial Possessions, notably the Capitol City of Dunwall. I fervently hope my tenure will be a short one, and that the rightful heir will take her place within a mere decade or so.
old: 我，<XXXX/> 海军上将法雷·哈弗洛克，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 谦卑地接受摄政王职权并接管格里斯托帝国及其皇家属地，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 特别是首都顿沃城。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我热切地希望我的任期将会是短暂的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而正统继承人将在近十年内接管她的权力。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我，<XXXX/> 海军上将法雷·哈弗洛克，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 谦卑地接受摄政王的职权，统治格里斯托国及其所有帝国属地，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 尤其是首都顿沃。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我热切地希望自己的任期十分短暂，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 而正统继承人将在短短十年左右后继位。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将 State of Gristol 误作“格里斯托帝国”，并将 rightful heir take her place 错译为“接管她的权力”；现按原意修正。

en: I won't go away! You can't kill me!  But I can kill you!
old: 我不会逃的！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你杀不死我！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但我会杀死你！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我不会消失的！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你杀不死我！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但我能杀死你！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 结合前句“不容易摆脱拉格斯奶奶”，go away 指她不会消失或被除掉，并非不会逃跑；当前译文纠正了原译引入的逃跑含义。

en: Well now, Mr. Pratchett, even a wealthy man like you needs the City Watch. Gangs are cutting throats and smashing windows left and right. And the weepers, excuse me, the plague victims, are worse. Are you saying the Lord Regent is wrong for imposing curfew?
old: 好吧，<XXXXXX/> 普莱切特先生，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 即使是像你一样的有钱人还是需要城市警卫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 黑帮成员正在割开别人的喉咙并把窗户震得左右摇摆。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 还有恸哭者，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不好意思，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 瘟疫的受害者，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 更加糟糕。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 难道你说摄政王强迫实行宵禁是错误的吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 好吧，<XXXXXX/> 普莱切特先生，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 即使是像你一样的有钱人还是需要城市警卫。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 黑帮成员正在四处割人喉咙、砸碎窗户。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 还有恸哭者，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不好意思，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 瘟疫的受害者，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 更加糟糕。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 难道你是说摄政王实施宵禁是错误的吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “left and right”表示四处作恶，并非把窗户震得左右摇摆；同时将生硬的“强迫实行宵禁”修正为“实施宵禁”。

en: I knew it! I read that some pirate ships have witches aboard that can cause storms or make whales do what they want. Is that true?
old: 我就知道！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我读到过有些海盗船上面有可以呼风唤雨和命令鲸鱼做他想做的事的巫师。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这是真的吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我就知道！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我读到过有些海盗船上有女巫，她们能呼风唤雨，或让鲸鱼听她们号令。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这是真的吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译将复数 witches 后续错指为单数男性“他”，且“做他想做的事”指代混乱。

en: Elementary Sums. History of the Isles, Geography of the Isles. The Seven Strictures. Litany of the White Cliff. Sayings of the Overseer. One day we'll get a few new books.

new: 《基础算术》、《群岛历史》、《群岛地理》、《七约令》、《白崖连祷文》、《督军的教诲》。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 哪天我们还要买些新书。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Elementary Sums”是基础算术，原译“元素概论”属于明显错译。

en: I apologize that my note led to bloodshed. I was honestly trying to patch things up, but - well, you met Lord Shaw. Here - take this for your trouble.
old: 我的字条引发了一起血案，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我对此十分抱歉。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我是真的想要把事情处理好，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但是——话说回来，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你见到了绍尔爵士对吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 给你——希望能补偿你所受的麻烦。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我的字条引发了一起血案，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我对此十分抱歉。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我是真的想要把事情处理好，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但是——话说回来，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你也见过绍尔勋爵了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 给你——希望能补偿你所受的麻烦。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “绍尔爵士”和疑问语气均属硬错，应改为陈述式的“绍尔勋爵”；末句原译已能对应 take this for your trouble，Medium 的进一步改写并非必要，故仅保留前述修补。

new: 你已经适应了新的安保措施了吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: He's been poisoned. There was a younger of your order in here before - an initiate perhaps. Detain him.
old: 他被毒死了。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 之前这里有一个你那一级的年轻人 - 可能是新人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 扣留他。<XXXXXXXX/>
new: 他中毒了。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 之前这里有一个你们教团的年轻人——可能是个见习者。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 扣留他。<XXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: poisoned 不等于已经毒死；your order 指所属教团而非“你那一级”，initiate 也应为见习者。

en: The Lower Guard: Drunkards and thieves in shoddy uniform.
old: 低阶警卫：穿着冒牌制服的酒鬼和窃贼。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 低阶警卫：穿着破旧制服的酒鬼和窃贼。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “shoddy uniform”指粗劣、破旧的制服，不是“冒牌制服”。

en: As you hunted down his people one by one, and finally came for him, he must have realized that all his planning was for nothing. And that must have been exquisitely terrifying.
old: 随着你一个又一个地干掉了他的手下，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 最终找到他头上，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他肯定已经意识到他的计划行不通了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这可真是令人毛骨悚然呐。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 随着你一个又一个地干掉了他的手下，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 最终找到他头上，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他肯定已经意识到他的计划行不通了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这对他而言一定是无比恐怖的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文说这种处境令“他”极度恐惧；“这可真是令人毛骨悚然”改成了泛指旁观者的感受，丢失明确的恐惧承受者。

new: 一天晚上我们全都去了韦弗利·波义耳家参加降灵会。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 那不过是消遣。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我们不知道自己在做什么。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 旧译误解 Waverly - Boyle's - 的插入停顿，导致人名与地点关系混乱；It was an amusement 指降灵会只是消遣。

en: You did right, Corvo. Even as a faithful man, I can see that.
old: 你做的很对，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 甚至作为一位充满信仰的人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也这么认为。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你做得很对，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 科尔沃。<XXXXXXXX/> 甚至作为一位充满信仰的人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也这么认为。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “做的很对”存在明显的“的/得”误用。

en: We were supposed to meet a boat I think.
old: 我想我们会遇见一艘船的。
new: 我想我们本来应该来和一艘船会合。

en: This one is no more than a pup. He'll grow into those paws.

new: 这只不过是条幼犬。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 等它长大，这些爪子就合适了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Medium 正确修复了原译的反义错误，但把复数 paws 写成限定两只的“这双爪子”，引入了数量错误；改为“这些爪子”，其余保留。

en: You're lucky I found them before the Admiral did.
old: 你该庆幸在上将行动前我发现了他们。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 你该庆幸我赶在上将之前发现了它们。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: before the Admiral did 指赶在上将发现它们之前，原译误成“上将行动前”。

en: You there? Who are you?
old: 你在那儿？你是谁？
new: 喂，那边的！你是谁？
reason: 人工裁决: 在这类警觉喊话中 You there 是对远处人物的招呼，并非询问对方是否位于某处；原译“你在那儿？”误解了话语功能。

en: Hear that, Granny? Whatever you got, Slackjaw gets a cut. Nothing personal, just Bottle Street rules.

en: What a handsome group of guards we have! I hope this plague lasts forever.

new: 我们的警卫个个都真英俊啊！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我真希望这瘟疫永远不要结束。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Custis is in the Gold Room with Violetta upstairs.
old: 寇斯提思和维奥莱塔在黄金间里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 寇斯提思和维奥莱塔在楼上的金屋里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: I seem to have lost something.

en: I made a list of all the swear words the Admiral uses! But Callista made me throw it away.

en: First item, I see the barrier is completed. Although I don't see what took so long.

new: 首先，<XXXXXX/> 我看见屏障完工了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不过我不明白为什么花了这么长时间。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

reason: 人工裁决: bring the City Watch on us 是“给我们招来城市警卫”，原译“把城市警卫带到这里”弱化了招惹麻烦的含义。

en: Officers lost their lives in there. I hope you showed respect.
old: 有官员在这里丧命了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我希望你能表现出相应的尊重。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 有警卫在里面丧命了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我希望你表现出了应有的尊重。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 监狱语境中的“Officers”指执勤警卫，译为“官员”会误导；同时将“in there”和已经发生的“showed”按原文修正。

en: He taught himself how to read.
old: 他自学成才。
new: 他自学识字。
reason: 人工裁决: 英文明确指他自学了阅读；“自学成才”范围过宽，遗漏了具体能力。

en: The other families dare not make a move without first approval from the three Ladies Boyle.
old: 波义耳家族的其他成员如果没有得到三位波义耳女士的首肯的话是不敢轻举妄动的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 其他家族如果没有先得到三位波义耳女士的首肯，便不敢轻举妄动。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “The other families”指波义耳家族以外的其他家族，原译误作波义耳家族内部的其他成员。

en: She thinks she's still at a Boyle mansion séance.
old: 她还以为自己在波义尔大宅的宴会上呢。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 她还以为自己在波义耳大宅的招魂会上呢。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: séance 明确指招魂会而非宴会；当前译文同时修正了波义耳姓氏，两个改动均属必要的硬错修补。

en: What the... !
new: 什么……！
reason: 人工裁决: 原译使用四个半角句点，属于明显标点错误；改为规范省略号。

en: The whale oil is in tanks filled with blue fluid. When they aren't drained, anyway.
old: 在它们还没被提纯的时候，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 鲸油是一种装在罐子里的蓝色液体。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 鲸油装在灌满蓝色液体的罐子里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 当然，前提是罐子还没被耗空。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文纠正了原译将 drained 误作“提纯”的硬错，并按原文顺序表达罐中鲸油尚未耗空的条件；改写虽大，但属纠正主句逻辑所必需。

en: Perhaps you ought to send her to me. And soon. She is a spoiled child, even if she's to be an Empress.
old: 也许你应该把她给我。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 尽管她只是个孩子，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不久后她就会成为女皇了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 也许你应该把她送到我这里来。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>而且要尽快。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>她是个被宠坏的孩子，即便她将成为女皇。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译漏掉“尽快送来”和 spoiled，并把 even if 的让步关系及成为女皇的时态译错。

en: It's a mystery. One that starts with a name. Delilah.
old: 一个谜团。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 一个开端为一个名字的谜团，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 黛莉拉。<XXXXXXXX/>
new: 一个谜团。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 一个始于某个名字的谜团，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 黛莉拉。<XXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: starts with a name 是“始于一个名字”，旧译“开端为一个名字”有明显直译腔。

en: ... for the Outsider himself has these five attributes by which he hopes to defeat the righteous.
old: ......因为界外魔自身有这五个属性，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他想利用这些来战胜正义。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: ......因为界外魔自身有这五个属性，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 他想利用这些来战胜正义之士。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “the righteous”指正义之人，原译“战胜正义”误成击败抽象概念。

en: Trust me, what's recorded on that card will do the trick. Good luck.
old: 相信我，<XXXXXXXX/> 那张录音卡上记录的东西将会改变一切。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 祝你好运。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 相信我，<XXXXXXXX/> 那张录音卡上记录的东西会奏效的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 祝你好运。<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: do the trick 表示“会奏效、能达到目的”，旧译“将会改变一切”明显夸大了原意。

en: Come to think on it, there aren't many honest men left these days.
old: 好好考虑考虑，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这世道已经没多少诚实的人了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 仔细想来，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这世道已经没多少诚实的人了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Come to think on it”是说话人想到某事后的感叹，原译“好好考虑考虑”误成对他人的劝告。

en: Waverly? That lucky trollop! If I'd found those crystal deposits on my estate, I'd be throwing parties, too. I'd be buying the Lord Regent's favor too instead of begging for money from my cousins.
old: 韦弗利？<XXXXXXXX/> 那个走运的荡妇！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>  如果在我的宅子里也储有水晶的话，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也要把它们全花在派对上。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我还要用它们买到摄政王的青睐而不是求着我的表兄弟借钱给我。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 韦弗利？<XXXXXXXX/> 那个走运的荡妇！<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果我的庄园里也发现了那些水晶矿藏，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我也会大办派对。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我还会花钱换取摄政王的青睐，而不是向我的表兄弟们低声下气地要钱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 当前文本纠正了把水晶矿藏当作可直接花用之物的误译，也准确表达了举办派对、购买摄政王青睐及向亲属讨钱；普通词 favor 未误套为“帮助”。

en: I'll see you executed. You won't be the first.
old: 我会看着你死去。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你不会是第一个。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我会看着你被处决。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你不会是第一个。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: executed 明确指依法或奉命处决，不只是泛指“死去”。

en: We'll put in warehouses all along this street. When the Hatters are gone, we could be rich in five years.
old: 我们要把整条街上都塞进仓库里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 然后等帽子帮一走，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们就能过上五年的富裕生活。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我们要沿着整条街建满仓库。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 等帽子帮一走，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们五年内就能发财。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: in five years 是五年内或五年后变富，并非只过五年富裕生活；原译同时将 warehouses all along the street 生硬译成“把整条街塞进仓库”。

en: Let's go. It's nearly midnight.  But easy, dammit. Keep'em in the boat. Canal's got enough shit in it as it is.
old: 我们走吧，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 已经快接近午夜了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但小心点，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 该死！<XXXXXX/> 把他们丢进船里。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这屎一般的运河里已经有足够多的屎了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我们走吧，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 已经快午夜了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但小心点，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 该死！<XXXXXX/> 别让他们掉出船。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 运河里的垃圾已经够多了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “Keep'em in the boat”是别让他们掉出船，原译误成把他们丢进船；末句逐字重复“屎”也形成明显生硬直译。

en: It's almost as if all forms of energy possess the same nature. Is it the same stuff that animates you and I? I wonder if the Overseers know...
old: 几乎所有形式的能源有拥有相同的属性。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我和你追求的到底是不是同一个东西呢？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这个大概得去问督军吧......
new: 几乎所有形式的能量似乎都具有相同的本质。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 赋予你我生命的也是同一种东西吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不知道督军是否知情......
reason: 人工裁决: 原译首句有病句，第二句将 animates you and I 错译为“你我追求”，第三句也误作“去问督军”，需整体修正。

en: Damn this old war wound in my hip. Son of a gun it aches these days
old: 该死，<XXXXXX/> 这屁股上的旧枪伤。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 这些天总他妈在疼。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 该死，<XXXXXX/> 我髋部的这处旧战伤。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 妈的，这些天疼得厉害。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “hip”是髋部而非屁股；“war wound”是战伤，原文未说明是枪伤。

en: How the years pass and the bodies fall. Did you know that there are only eight like you in the world, bearing my mark?
old: 时间随年流逝的同时尸体逐年增加。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你知不知道这个世界上只有八个人像你一样，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 承载着我的记号？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 岁月流逝，尸体倒下。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 你知不知道这个世界上只有八个人像你一样，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 承载着我的记号？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 首句准确保留 years pass 与 bodies fall 的并列意象，并修复原译擅自加入的“逐年增加”关系；小写 world 在此按普通名词译为“世界”，不存在专名误套。

en: Not that the streets around us are pleasant, but there's no rioting at least. It's better that we're hidden here in one of the more desolated sections of the city.
old: 不仅我们周围的街道变得舒适，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 至少现在已经没有暴乱了。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 更关键的在于我们现在正藏身于城市最荒凉的区域之一。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我们周围的街道谈不上舒适，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但至少没有发生暴乱。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 好在我们藏身于城市中较为荒凉的区域之一。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: Not that the streets around us are pleasant 表示街道并不宜人，原译“不仅……变得舒适”将含义完全颠倒。

en: Do Custis and Morgan Pendleton know that your men spend half their time flirting?
old: 寇斯提思和摩根知道你的手下值勤时打情骂俏吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 寇斯提思和摩根·潘德顿知道你的手下有一半时间都在打情骂俏吗？<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译明确遗漏了姓氏 Pendleton 和 half their time；当前文本完整恢复姓名及时间占比，修补必要且准确。

en: The officers of the Watch made him cut his hair.
old: 值班驾驶员让他剪头发。
new: 城市警卫的长官让他剪了头发。
reason: 人工裁决: officers of the Watch 指城市警卫的长官，原译“值班驾驶员”属于明显错译。

en: I'll take care of it myself, if that's the way you feel.
old: 我会搞定自己的事情，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果你也是这样想的话。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 我会亲自处理这件事，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 既然你是这么想的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “take care of it myself”指亲自处理当前所谈之事，并非处理自己的事情。

en: Eventually. Sure. He's the only one can tell us about the pearls. But let him rot in a cell a while longer. He'll be more careful next time.
old: 最终会的。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 他是唯一能告诉我们有关珍珠的信息的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但在此之前先让他在监狱里再待上一会儿吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 下一次他会更加小心的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 迟早会的。当然。<XXXXXXXXXX/> 他是唯一能告诉我们有关珍珠的信息的人。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但在此之前先让他在监狱里再待上一会儿吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 下一次他会更加小心的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译遗漏了独立回应“Sure”，需补回“当然”。

en: Some killer is making his way through the establishment.
old: 有些杀手是从设施里出来的。
new: 有个杀手正在这地方一路杀人。
reason: 人工裁决: 原文指单个杀手正在场所内一路推进，原译误成多个杀手从设施中出来；Medium 已纠正数量、方向和正在发生的威胁。

en: Corrrvoooo. I want to tell you something. Come here!
old: 科尔沃 - 。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我想告诉你点事。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 到这儿来！<XXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 科尔沃——。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我想告诉你点事。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 到这儿来！<XXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文 Corrrvoooo 是拖长声音呼唤科尔沃，旧译“科尔沃 - 。”使用半角连字符且标点明显错误。

en: This cell isn't supposed to be open, dammit.
old: 这房间本不应该打开的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 该死。<XXXXXX/>
new: 这牢房本不应该打开的，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 该死。<XXXXXX/>

en: This is Daud. Mr. Rothwild is dead. Take the rest of the day off.
old: 这里是道德。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 罗斯维德先生死了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 剩下的日子放假。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这里是道德。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 罗斯维德先生死了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 今天剩下的时间放假。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>

en: Go ahead. Get it over with.

new: 动手吧。赶紧结束这一切。
reason: 人工裁决: 当前译文准确传达让对方动手并尽快了结此事的含义，修正了旧译“把事说完”的明确错译。

en: Let's make these witches regret following Delilah to this moldy ruin.
old: 让我们使这些女巫后悔跟随黛莉拉来到这个发霉的废墟。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 让这些女巫后悔跟随黛莉拉来到这片发霉的废墟。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 旧译“使这些女巫后悔”带有明显生硬直译腔，最小调整为自然口语表达。

en: Keep away or I'll slit your ricker for you.
old: 走开，<XXXXXX/> 不然我就要把你这个傻瓜撕碎。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 走开，<XXXXXX/> 不然我就割开你的喉咙。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 裁决证据已确认固定短语 slit your ricker 是持刀割喉威胁；当前“把你这个傻瓜撕碎”误把人体指代当作辱称并改变了具体动作。标签顺序和数量保持不变。

old: 顿沃城市民请注意：由于近期摄政王被揭露蓄意导致鼠疫的爆发，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 市政府将迎来必要重组阶段。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 请持续关注事态后续发展。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 顿沃城市民请注意：近期披露的摄政王在鼠疫爆发前一系列事件中所起的作用，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 使市政府有必要进入重组阶段。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 请持续关注后续公告。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原文仅称摄政王在导致鼠疫爆发的事件中扮演角色，原译擅自添加“蓄意导致”；现去除未明说的主观意图。

en: Please, call me Arnold. We're friends!
old: 请请，<XXXXXX/> 叫我阿诺德。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们是朋友！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 请，<XXXXXX/> 叫我阿诺德。<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们是朋友！<XXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译“请请”是明显的文字重复错误。

en: This is yours. The key to Emily's cell. She'll be glad to see you.
old: 这是你的了，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 艾米丽房间的钥匙，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她看到你会很高兴的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 这是你的了，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 艾米莉牢房的钥匙，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 她看到你会很高兴的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 人名已正确统一为“艾米莉”，但 cell 明确是关押艾米莉的牢房，不是普通“房间”，须补修这一实物类型错误。

en: Oh cut the crap, will you? Once you're out it will be out of sight, out of mind. Go throw yourself off a cliff.
old: 哦别说屁话了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 行吗？<XXXXXX/> 你出去了以后很快就会丧失视力和心智的。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 自己跳崖去吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 哦，别说屁话了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 行吗？<XXXXXX/> 你一出去就会眼不见、心不烦。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 自己跳崖去吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: out of sight, out of mind 是“眼不见、心不烦”，原译成丧失视力和心智属于明显错译。

en: Looks like something is wrong with the outer door.
old: 看起来门外有动静。
new: 看起来外门出了问题。
reason: 人工裁决: 原文是外门本身出了故障，原译“门外有动静”误成门外发生异动。

en: Shut your mouths, both of you. We're Pendleton's men. Live or die, we're going to act like it.
old: 给我闭嘴，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你也一样！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我们是潘德顿的人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不管活着还是死了，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们至少要做的像样一点。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 给我闭嘴，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你们两个都一样！<XXXXXXXXXX/> 我们是潘德顿的人，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 不管是生是死，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我们都得有个潘德顿手下的样子。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 末句要求众人表现得像潘德顿的手下，原译“至少要做得像样一点”遗漏了这一明确含义。

en: You see? You're outmatched, Daud. Genius always wins.
old: 看到了吗？<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你被超过了，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 道德。<XXXXXX/> 天才往往会是赢家。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
new: 看到了吗？<XXXXXXXXXX/> 你不是对手，<XXXXXXXXXXXX/> 道德。<XXXXXX/> 天才总会胜出。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: “outmatched”指实力不及对手，原译“被超过了”生硬且语义不清；“always”应译为“总会”而非“往往”。

That's not how it works, once the bureaucrats step in. Everything gets muddy. If anyone ever knew, we'd all lose our heads for this. So no one can know. And could we ever control Emily with Corvo around? That's the question that sticks in my mind. We need to make our final move, and we need to make it cleanly. No loose ends. Only a few in the know. The ones with the most to lose.

new: 结局将至，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 看着你用意志对抗自己启动的机器，实在壮丽。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 万物都将终结，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 一切将化为灰烬，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 但你，<XXXXXXXX/> 我的朋友，<XXXXXXXXXX/> 却燃烧得如此明亮。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
reason: 人工裁决: 原译把“The end is coming”错成已经结束，并把“glorious”错解为说话者感到荣幸；末句也应是燃烧得明亮，而非燃成一道亮光。

Thank you all and good night.

en: Emily, my daughter, I know that one day you'll be grown up, and I wonder what you'll remember of these years. Will you recall your time as a child with fondness? Or were there too many caretakers, formal dinners and lessons about boring old history? Maybe the precious hours we spent together will shine brighter; time captured now and then with your mother and with Corvo, who was always close to my heart. I hope the season of rats and plague will be nothing more than a passing shadow on your early memories. A crisis come and passed, weathered by your mother and her advisors. You'll sit on the throne someday, and will do well I hope. It's a tricky life, full of responsibility and peril. It was not your choice to be the daughter of an Empress, but I believe you'll rise to the challenge. Stay good-hearted, Emily. Keep drawing and telling stories. And only share your power with those you truly trust.

en: This building has stood here for over three centuries. As long as Lord Pendleton calls it home, I would defend it with my life. I may well have to.

en: There you are. Now go to the target and you'll get a treat.

en: Me and my boys have smuggled more whale oil than you can imagine past here. You help me and I'll owe you a favor. Trust old Blake on that.

new: 好吧我知道在这儿我也帮不上什么，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 所以我会自己回到狗圈酒吧。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 如果我看见船夫萨缪尔，<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/> 我会告诉他去至高督军办公室后面的院子接你。<XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/>
